3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: operations O1–O16
5	
6	The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §60–§75. Each
7	operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
8	an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
9	relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
10	`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
11	-/
12	
13	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
14	
15	/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
16	effects of §72 and §73). -/
17	def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
18	  | _, [] => []
19	  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l
20	
21	/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/
22	
23	/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
24	identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
25	def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
26	  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩
27	
28	/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
29	structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
30	  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
31	  active : s.Active src
32	  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
33	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
34	  /-- §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source`, its effective anchor included, is
35	  active. -/
36	  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x
37	  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
38	  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
39	  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
40	  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
41	  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
42	  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
43	  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
44	  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
45	  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
46	    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
47	    True
48	  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
49	  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F
50	
51	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
52	instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
53	    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
54	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ (∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x) ∧
55	    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
56	    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
57	    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
58	      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
59	      True) ∧
60	    s.top ∈ s.F)
61	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
62	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩
63	
64	/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
65	def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
66	  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)
67	
68	/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/
69	
70	/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
71	per region, held by the current frame. -/
72	def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
73	  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }
74	
75	/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
76	descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
77	def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
78	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
79	    False
80	
81	/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
82	instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
83	  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance
84	
85	/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
86	structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
87	  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
88	  active : s.Active src
89	  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
90	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
91	  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
92	  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
93	  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
94	  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
95	  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
96	  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
97	  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
98	  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p
99	
100	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
101	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
102	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
103	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
104	    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
105	    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
106	    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
107	    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
108	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩
109	
110	/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
111	def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
112	  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)
113	
114	/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/
115	
116	/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
117	the anchors of its holding place. -/
118	def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
119	  | some x => { s with
120	      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
121	      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
122	  | none => s
123	
124	/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
125	the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
126	def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
127	  | .frame f => f = s.top
128	  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p
129	
130	/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
131	instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
132	  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance
133	
134	/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
135	structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
136	  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
137	  active : s.Active a
138	  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
139	  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
140	  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
141	  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
142	  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
143	  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
144	  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
145	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
146	    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)
147	
148	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
149	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
150	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
151	    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
152	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
153	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
154	      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
155	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
156	
157	/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
158	def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
159	  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)
160	
161	/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/
162	
163	/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
164	def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
165	  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)
166	
167	/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
168	def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
169	  | [] => 0
170	  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1
171	
172	/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
173	position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
174	def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
175	  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
176	  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
177	      match parentOf P r with
178	      | some p => if p < r then
179	          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
180	      | none => none
181	
182	/-- `corr(r)` (§63.2, §63.8): the part of `dst` corresponding to the part `r` of `src`. -/
183	def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r
184	
185	/-- Same shape of ordered subtrees (§63.2): every part of `src` has a corresponding part of `dst`
186	with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part of `src`. -/
187	def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
188	  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
189	    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
190	  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
191	    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z
192	
193	/-- Decidability of `SameShape` (§63.2). -/
194	instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
195	  unfold SameShape; infer_instance
196	
197	/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
198	def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
199	  | .place r => partOf P r q
200	  | .frame _ => False
201	
202	/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
203	instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
204	  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance
205	
206	/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
207	`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
208	def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
209	  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
210	  | .frame f => .frame f
211	
212	/-- Anchors moved onto place `q` by the transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): those of every
213	part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
214	def movedTo (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : List Nat :=
215	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r =>
216	    decide (partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q)).flatMap s.D
217	
218	/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (§63, `ok` effect): source leaves `Moved`,
219	destination leaves `Init`; authorities held by part `r` of `src`, and places owned by `r`, move
220	to `corr(r)`; the anchors of `r` follow `corr(r)`. -/
221	def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
222	  { s with
223	    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
224	      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
225	    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
226	      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
227	    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q
228	    A := s.A.map fun y =>
229	      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }
230	
231	/-- Active derived authority covering a leaf of `src` and not held within it (§63.4). -/
232	def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
233	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
234	    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False
235	
236	/-- Decidability of `ActiveDerivedOutside` (§63.4). -/
237	instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
238	  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance
239	
240	/-- The holder moves with the value at `src` (§63.6, §63.7): a part of `src` or storage it owns,
241	transitively. -/
242	def HolderMoves (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Holder → Prop
243	  | .place p => partOf s.P p src ∨ OwnedIn s.P src p
244	  | .frame _ => False
245	
246	/-- Decidability of `HolderMoves` (§63.7). -/
247	instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderMoves s src h) := by
248	  cases h <;> unfold HolderMoves <;> infer_instance
249	
250	/-- Authority `x` is a moved held authority (§63.7): its holder moves with the value at `src`. -/
251	def AnchorMoves (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Prop :=
252	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => HolderMoves s src y.holder) False
253	
254	/-- Decidability of `AnchorMoves` (§63.7). -/
255	instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
256	  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance
257	
258	/-- Dependencies of the usable places following the value at `src` (§63.6): the anchors of its
259	parts and of the usable storage it owns, transitively. -/
260	def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
261	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
262	    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D
263	
264	/-- Leaves of a holder (§63.8): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
265	def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
266	  | .place p => footprint s.P p
267	  | .frame _ => []
268	
269	/-- Authority `a` is active and covers a leaf of its own holder (§63.8). -/
270	def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
271	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False
272	
273	/-- Decidability of `SelfLock` (§63.8). -/
274	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance
275	
276	/-- Local self-blocking prevention (§63.8): no authority held before the step within `src` covers,
277	in the resulting state, a leaf of its new holder `corr(r)`. -/
278	def NoLocalSelfLock (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
279	  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
280	    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j
281	
282	/-- Decidability of `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
283	instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoLocalSelfLock s src dst) := by
284	  unfold NoLocalSelfLock; infer_instance
285	
286	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
287	structure TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
288	  /-- §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
289	  srcUsable : s.Usable src
290	  /-- §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
291	  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
292	  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
293	  srcRight : HasRight s .modify src
294	  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
295	  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
296	  /-- §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
297	  sameShape : SameShape s.P src dst
298	  /-- §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
299	  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init
300	  /-- §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
301	  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init
302	  /-- §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
303	  disjoint : ¬ overlap s.P src dst
304	  /-- §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source, except the
305	  authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over the source: some authority
306	  grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
307	  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
308	    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j
309	  /-- §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
310	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false
311	  /-- §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
312	  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x
313	  /-- §63.6: `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state. -/
314	  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst)
315	  /-- §63.7: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
316	  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
317	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
318	      OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
319	        EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True
320	  /-- §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
321	  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock s src dst
322	  /-- §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
323	  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst
324	
325	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
326	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
327	    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) :=
328	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧
329	    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
330	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
331	    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
332	      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j) ∧
333	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
334	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
335	    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
336	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
337	        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
338	          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
339	    NoLocalSelfLock s src dst ∧ (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst)
340	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
341	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
342	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
343	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩
344	
345	/-- `transfer` as a relation (§63). -/
346	def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
347	  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)
348

3	/-!
4	# Renaming of identities: derived notions of a state
5	
6	Equivariance of the state-level notions of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` read by
7	the operations O1–O16 and by the invariants, under related states (§38; §49, last paragraph): the
8	current frame (§39), origin chains and effective anchors (§42, §44), activity (§42), usability,
9	frames of places and live holders (§40, §49.8), effective modes (§43), exercise and the
10	grounding of a right (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3), dependencies (§44), anchor order (§44, §54),
11	dynamic pinning (§74) and leaves of usable places (§66.1).
12	
13	Iff lemmas are proved in one direction and closed by symmetry (`SRel.symm`).
14	-/

28	  simp only [S3.org]

30	  | none => rw [(h.A_none j).1 hy]; rfl
31	  | some y =>
32	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
33	    rw [hy', Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, hr.origin]

52	  constructor
53	  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩
54	    obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
55	    exact ⟨y, hy, by rw [← hr.active]; exact ha⟩
56	  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩
57	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
58	    exact ⟨y', hy', by rw [hr.active]; exact ha⟩

61	theorem SRel.mem_D (h : SRel π α s s') (q x : Nat) : α.f x ∈ s'.D (π.f q) ↔ x ∈ s.D q :=

75	
76	/-- `Usable` is preserved forward (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
77	theorem SRel.usable_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q) : s'.Usable (π.f q) := by
78	  induction hq with
79	  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
80	    rename_i f _
81	    exact .frame (f := f) (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)
82	      (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) (by rw [h.F]; exact hf)
83	  | place hpl hd ho _ ih =>
84	    exact .place (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)

88	theorem SRel.usable (h : SRel π α s s') (q : Nat) : s'.Usable (π.f q) ↔ s.Usable q :=
89	  ⟨fun hq => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.usable_of hq, h.usable_of⟩

95	  | frame f => show f ∈ s'.F ↔ f ∈ s.F; rw [h.F]
96	  | place p => exact h.usable p

99	theorem SRel.frameOf_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q f : Nat} (hq : FrameOf s q f) :
100	    FrameOf s' (π.f q) f := by
101	  induction hq with
102	  | frame hpl ho =>
103	    exact .frame (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren])
104	  | place hpl ho _ ih =>
105	    exact .place (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih
106	
107	/-- `FrameOf` is invariant; frames are not renamed (§40, `placeFrame`; §49, last paragraph). -/
108	theorem SRel.frameOf (h : SRel π α s s') (q f : Nat) : FrameOf s' (π.f q) f ↔ FrameOf s q f :=
109	  ⟨fun hq => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.frameOf_of hq, h.frameOf_of⟩

112	theorem SRel.pframe (h : SRel π α s s') (q : Nat) : s'.pframe (π.f q) = s.pframe q :=

118	  | frame f => rfl
119	  | place p => exact h.pframe p

123	/-- Modes of covering active descendants are invariant as a set (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
124	theorem SRel.mem_descModes (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a p : Nat)
125	    (m : Mode) : m ∈ descModes s' (α.f a) (π.f p) ↔ m ∈ descModes s a p := by
126	  simp only [Access.mem_descModes]
127	  constructor
128	  · rintro ⟨j, y', hy', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
129	    rw [← α.fg j] at hy' h3
130	    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyy⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
131	    refine ⟨α.g j, y, hy, hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).1 h2,
132	      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).1 h3, hyy.mode ▸ h4⟩
133	  · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
134	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy⟩ := h.A_some hy
135	    exact ⟨α.f j, y', hy', hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).2 h2,
136	      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).2 h3, hyy.mode.symm ▸ h4⟩

139	theorem effOf_congr {m : Mode} {ds ds' : List Mode} (h : ∀ x, x ∈ ds ↔ x ∈ ds') :
140	    effOf m ds = effOf m ds' := by
141	  have h0 : ds = [] ↔ ds' = [] := by simp only [List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem, h]

151	    simp only [Access.effective, hy, hy', hr.active, hr.mem_footprint, hr.mode,

160	  | some y =>

168	/-- Sufficient effective mode over a footprint is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
169	theorem SRel.forall_footprint_allows (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
170	    (q a : Nat) (m : Mode) :
171	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f q), Allows (Access.effective s' (α.f a) l) m) ↔
172	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (Access.effective s a l) m :=

174	    (fun l => by rw [h.effective hd hd'])

176	/-! ## Exercise and rights (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3) -/
177	
178	/-- `ExercisableAt` is preserved forward (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
179	theorem SRel.exercisableAt_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') {a : Nat}
180	    {m : Mode} (he : s.ExercisableAt a m) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m := by
181	  induction he with
182	  | base hy ha hm hf =>
183	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
184	    exact .base hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
185	      (by rw [hr.holder, hf, h.top]; rfl)
186	  | held hy ha hm hp _ hc ih =>
187	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
188	    exact .held hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
189	      (by rw [hr.holder, hp]; rfl) ih ((h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' _ _ _).2 hc)

191	/-- `ExercisableAt` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
192	theorem SRel.exercisableAt (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a : Nat)
193	    (m : Mode) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m ↔ s.ExercisableAt a m :=
194	  ⟨fun he => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, α.gf] using h.symm.exercisableAt_of hd' hd he,
195	   h.exercisableAt_of hd hd'⟩
196	
197	/-- `HasRight` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
198	theorem SRel.hasRight (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (m : Mode) (q : Nat) :
199	    HasRight s' m (π.f q) ↔ HasRight s m q :=
200	  α.exists_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun a =>
201	    and_congr (h.exercisableAt hd hd' a m) (h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' q a m)
202	
203	/-- `Grounds` is invariant (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
204	theorem SRel.grounds (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) :
205	    Grounds s' m (π.f q) (α.f g) ↔ Grounds s m q g :=
206	  and_congr (h.mem_rangeA g)
207	    (and_congr (h.exercisableAt hd hd' g m) (h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' q g m))
208	
209	/-- `RightChain` is invariant (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
210	theorem SRel.rightChain (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (g j : Nat) :
211	    RightChain s' (α.f g) (α.f j) ↔ RightChain s g j :=
212	  or_congr α.f_inj (h.mem_ancs hd hd' g j)
213	
214	/-! ## Dependencies and anchor order (§44, §54) -/
215	
216	/-- Anchors gathered over the places selected by corresponding predicates correspond up to
217	permutation (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §63, `ok` effect; §49, last paragraph). -/
218	theorem SRel.filter_flatMap_D (h : SRel π α s s') {Q Q' : Nat → Bool}
219	    (hQ : ∀ r, Q' (π.f r) = Q r) :
220	    (((List.range s'.P.length).filter Q').flatMap s'.D).Perm
221	      ((((List.range s.P.length).filter Q).flatMap s.D).map α.f) := by
222	  have hL : ((List.range s'.P.length).filter Q').Perm
223	      (((List.range s.P.length).filter Q).map π.f) :=
224	    π.perm_of_mem (List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range)
225	      (List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range) fun r => by
226	        simp only [List.mem_filter, h.P.mem_range, hQ]
227	  refine (hL.flatMap_right s'.D).trans ?_
228	  rw [List.flatMap_map, List.map_flatMap]
229	  exact perm_flatMap_pointwise fun r _ => h.D r
230	
231	/-- Inherited anchors correspond up to permutation (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
232	theorem SRel.depsOf (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (q : Nat) :
233	    (Access.depsOf s' (π.f q)).Perm ((Access.depsOf s q).map α.f) :=
234	  h.filter_flatMap_D fun r => decide_eq_decide.2 (partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 r q)
235	
236	/-- `DepsValid` is invariant (§44; §66.3, §67.3, §68.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
237	theorem SRel.depsValid (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (p : Nat) :
238	    DepsValid s' (π.f p) ↔ DepsValid s p :=
239	  π.forall_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q => by
240	    rw [partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1]
241	    exact imp_congr_right fun _ => α.forall_mem_iff (h.mem_D q) h.active
242	
243	/-- `EffAnchorOK` is invariant; frames are not renamed (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
244	theorem SRel.effAnchorOK (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (x : Nat)
245	    (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOK s' (α.f x) fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
246	  unfold EffAnchorOK
247	  rw [h.effAnchor hd hd']
248	  cases hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? with
249	  | none => rw [(h.A_none _).1 hz]; exact Iff.rfl
250	  | some z =>
251	    obtain ⟨z', hz', hr⟩ := h.A_some hz
252	    rw [hz']
253	    simp only [OptP, hr.holder, h.hframe, h.F]
254	
255	/-- `AnchorOrder` is preserved forward (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
256	theorem SRel.anchorOrder_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
257	    (ha : AnchorOrder s) : AnchorOrder s' := by
258	  intro q' hq' x' hx'
259	  rw [← π.fg q'] at hq' hx' ⊢
260	  rw [← α.fg x'] at hx' ⊢
261	  rw [h.pframe, h.effAnchorOK hd hd']
262	  exact ha _ ((h.usable _).1 hq') _ ((h.mem_D _ _).1 hx')
263	
264	/-- `AnchorOrder` is invariant (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
265	theorem SRel.anchorOrder (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') :
266	    AnchorOrder s' ↔ AnchorOrder s :=
267	  ⟨h.symm.anchorOrder_of hd' hd, h.anchorOrder_of hd hd'⟩
268	
269	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` is preserved forward (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
270	theorem SRel.anchorOrderHeld_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
271	    (ha : AnchorOrderHeld s) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
272	  intro q' hq' x' y' hy' ya hh
273	  rw [← π.fg q'] at hq' hh ⊢
274	  rw [← α.fg x'] at hy' ⊢
275	  obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
276	  rw [h.pframe, h.effAnchorOK hd hd']
277	  rw [hr.holder] at hh
278	  exact ha _ ((h.usable _).1 hq') _ y hy (by rw [← hr.active]; exact ya)
279	    ((Holder.ren_inj π (b := .place (π.g q'))).1 hh)
280	
281	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` is invariant (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
282	theorem SRel.anchorOrderHeld (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') :
283	    AnchorOrderHeld s' ↔ AnchorOrderHeld s :=
284	  ⟨h.symm.anchorOrderHeld_of hd' hd, h.anchorOrderHeld_of hd hd'⟩
285	
286	/-! ## Dynamic pinning, leaves of usable places (§74, §66.1) -/
287	
288	/-- Dynamic pinning is invariant (§74; §49, last paragraph). -/
289	theorem SRel.pin (h : SRel π α s s') (l : Nat) : s'.pin (π.f l) = s.pin l := by
290	  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, S3.pin_iff, S3.pin_iff]
291	  constructor
292	  · rintro ⟨i, ob', hob', ha, hl⟩
293	    obtain ⟨ob, hob, hr⟩ := h.pins_some' hob'
294	    exact ⟨i, ob, hob, by rw [← hr.active]; exact ha, (hr.mem_leaves l).1 hl⟩
295	  · rintro ⟨i, ob, hob, ha, hl⟩
296	    obtain ⟨ob', hob', hr⟩ := h.pins_some hob
297	    exact ⟨i, ob', hob', by rw [hr.active]; exact ha, (hr.mem_leaves l).2 hl⟩
298	
299	/-- `LeafOfUsable` is invariant (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1; §49, last paragraph). -/
300	theorem SRel.leafOfUsable (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (l : Nat) :
301	    LeafOfUsable s' (π.f l) ↔ LeafOfUsable s l :=
302	  π.exists_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q => and_congr (h.usable q) (h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q)
303

3	/-!
4	# Renaming of identities: places
5	
6	Equivariance of the place-level notions of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` under a
7	renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): parent chains, parts, leaves and footprints (§40),
8	overlap (§63.3), transitive ownership (§40), root places (§40), released units (§70), children,
9	positional correspondence and same shape (§63.2), holders within a value and their move (§63),
10	and the places appended from a shape (§47, §71, §72).
11	-/
12	
13	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename
14	
15	variable {π : Ren} {P P' : List Place}
16	
17	/-- A renamed option is a renamed `some` exactly when the option is that `some` (§49, last
18	paragraph). -/
19	theorem Ren.option_map_eq_some (π : Ren) (o : Option Nat) (x : Nat) :
20	    o.map π.f = some (π.f x) ↔ o = some x := by
21	  cases o <;> simp [Ren.f_inj]
22	
23	/-! ## Chains, parts, leaves, footprints (§40) -/
24	
25	/-- Chains along links related by an injective map, both downward, correspond (§40 parents, §42
26	origins; §49, last paragraph). -/
27	theorem chain_ren {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
28	    (hd : ∀ j o, org j = some o → o < j) (hd' : ∀ j o, org' j = some o → o < j)
29	    (h : ∀ j, org' (f j) = (org j).map f) : ∀ i, chain org' (f i) = (chain org i).map f := by
30	  intro i
31	  induction i using Nat.strongRecOn with
32	  | _ i ih =>
33	    cases ho : org i with
34	    | none => rw [chain_none ho, chain_none (by rw [h, ho]; rfl)]; rfl
35	    | some o =>
36	      have h' : org' (f i) = some (f o) := by rw [h, ho]; rfl
37	      rw [chain_cons ho (hd _ _ ho), chain_cons h' (hd' _ _ h'), ih o (hd _ _ ho)]
38	      rfl
39	
40	/-- Structural parents of related place lists correspond (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
41	theorem PRel.parentOf (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) :
42	    parentOf P' (π.f q) = (parentOf P q).map π.f := by
43	  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, hP.get]
44	  cases P[q]? <;> simp [Place.ren]
45	
46	/-- A renamed place has the renamed parent exactly when the place has that parent (§40; §49,
47	last paragraph). -/
48	theorem PRel.parentOf_eq_some (hP : PRel π P P') (q p : Nat) :
49	    Access.parentOf P' (π.f q) = some (π.f p) ↔ Access.parentOf P q = some p := by
50	  rw [hP.parentOf, π.option_map_eq_some]
51	
52	/-- Structural parent chains correspond (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
53	theorem chainP_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) :
54	    chain (parentOf P') (π.f q) = (chain (parentOf P) q).map π.f :=
55	  chain_ren hd hd' hP.parentOf q
56	
57	/-- `partOf` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
58	theorem partOf_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (p q : Nat) :
59	    partOf P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ partOf P p q := by
60	  simp only [partOf, hP.lt_iff, chainP_ren hP hd hd', π.mem_map_f, Ren.f_inj]
61	
62	/-- Leaves are invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
63	theorem isLeaf_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (l : Nat) : isLeaf P' (π.f l) ↔ isLeaf P l := by
64	  unfold isLeaf
65	  refine π.forall_iff fun r => ?_
66	  rw [hP.lt_iff, Ne, hP.parentOf_eq_some]
67	
68	/-- `footprint` membership is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
69	theorem mem_footprint_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (l q : Nat) :
70	    π.f l ∈ footprint P' (π.f q) ↔ l ∈ footprint P q := by
71	  simp only [mem_footprint, hP.lt_iff, isLeaf_ren hP, partOf_ren hP hd hd']
72	
73	/-- A footprint has no duplicate (§40: a set of leaves; §49, last paragraph). -/
74	theorem footprint_nodup (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : (footprint P q).Nodup :=
75	  List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range
76	
77	/-- Footprints correspond up to permutation (§40, §42: a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
78	theorem footprint_perm_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) :
79	    (footprint P' (π.f q)).Perm ((footprint P q).map π.f) :=
80	  π.perm_of_mem (footprint_nodup P q) (footprint_nodup P' _) fun l =>
81	    mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' l q
82	
83	/-- `overlap` is invariant (§63.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
84	theorem overlap_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (p q : Nat) :
85	    overlap P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ overlap P p q :=
86	  π.exists_mem_iff (fun x => mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' x p)
87	    (fun x => mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' x q)
88	
89	/-! ## Ownership, root places, released units (§40, §70) -/
90	
91	/-- `OwnedIn` is preserved forward (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
92	theorem ownedIn_ren_of (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') {src q : Nat}
93	    (h : OwnedIn P src q) : OwnedIn P' (π.f src) (π.f q) := by
94	  induction h with
95	  | direct hpl ho hp =>
96	    exact .direct (by rw [hP.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren])
97	      ((partOf_ren hP hd hd' _ _).2 hp)
98	  | step hpl ho _ ih =>
99	    exact .step (by rw [hP.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih
100	
101	/-- `OwnedIn` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
102	theorem ownedIn_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (src q : Nat) :
103	    OwnedIn P' (π.f src) (π.f q) ↔ OwnedIn P src q :=
104	  ⟨fun h => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using ownedIn_ren_of hP.symm hd' hd h,
105	   ownedIn_ren_of hP hd hd'⟩
106	
107	/-- Root places are invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
108	theorem rootPlace_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (r : Nat) : RootPlace P' (π.f r) ↔ RootPlace P r := by
109	  simp only [RootPlace, hP.lt_iff, hP.parentOf, Option.map_eq_none_iff]
110	
111	/-- Places of a released unit are invariant (§70; §49, last paragraph). -/
112	theorem freedPlace_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (p q : Nat) :
113	    FreedPlace P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ FreedPlace P p q := by
114	  simp only [FreedPlace, partOf_ren hP hd hd', ownedIn_ren hP hd hd']
115	
116	/-! ## Children, correspondence, same shape (§63.2) -/
117	
118	/-- Children are listed in increasing index order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
119	theorem kids_sorted (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : (kids P x).Pairwise (· < ·) :=
120	  List.pairwise_lt_range.filter _
121	
122	/-- Children correspond in order when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
123	theorem kids_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) (x : Nat) :
124	    kids P' (π.f x) = (kids P x).map π.f := by
125	  apply eq_of_sorted_mem (kids_sorted P' _)
126	  · rw [List.pairwise_map]
127	    refine (kids_sorted P x).imp_of_mem fun {a b} ha hb hab => ?_
128	    exact hs a b x (mem_kids.1 ha).2 (mem_kids.1 hb).2 hab
129	  · intro a
130	    rw [← π.fg a, π.mem_map_f, mem_kids, mem_kids, hP.lt_iff, hP.parentOf_eq_some]
131	
132	/-- `corr` of a part without parent other than `src` is undefined (§63.2; §49, last
133	paragraph). -/
134	theorem corr_none {src dst r : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src) (hp : parentOf P r = none) :
135	    corr P src dst r = none := by
136	  unfold corr; cases r <;> simp [corrF, hr, hp]
137	
138	/-- `corr` is equivariant when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
139	theorem corr_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
140	    (src dst : Nat) : ∀ r, corr P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) (π.f r) = (corr P src dst r).map π.f := by
141	  intro r
142	  induction r using Nat.strongRecOn with
143	  | _ r ih =>
144	    by_cases hr : r = src
145	    · subst hr; rw [corr_src, corr_src]; rfl
146	    · have hr' : π.f r ≠ π.f src := fun e => hr ((Ren.f_inj π).1 e)
147	      cases hp : parentOf P r with
148	      | none =>
149	        rw [corr_none hr hp, corr_none hr' (by rw [hP.parentOf, hp]; rfl)]; rfl
150	      | some p =>
151	        have hp' : parentOf P' (π.f r) = some (π.f p) := by rw [hP.parentOf, hp]; rfl
152	        rw [corr_step hr hp (hd _ _ hp), corr_step hr' hp' (hd' _ _ hp'), ih p (hd _ _ hp),
153	          kids_ren hP hs p, posIn_map (fun _ _ e => (Ren.f_inj π).1 e)]
154	        cases corr P src dst p with
155	        | none => rfl
156	        | some p0 =>
157	          simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, kids_ren hP hs p0, List.getElem?_map]
158	
159	/-- `SameShape` is invariant when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
160	theorem sameShape_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
161	    (src dst : Nat) : SameShape P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) ↔ SameShape P src dst := by
162	  unfold SameShape
163	  refine and_congr (π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun r => ?_)
164	    (π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun z => ?_)
165	  · rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd', corr_ren hP hd hd' hs]
166	    refine imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
167	    cases corr P src dst r with
168	    | none => exact Iff.rfl
169	    | some c => simp only [Option.map_some, OptP, kids_ren hP hs, List.length_map]
170	  · rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd']
171	    refine imp_congr_right fun _ => π.exists_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun r => ?_
172	    rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd', corr_ren hP hd hd' hs, π.option_map_eq_some]
173	
174	/-! ## Holders within a value and their move (§63, §69, §70) -/
175	
176	/-- `heldIn` is invariant (§63, §69, §70; §49, last paragraph). -/
177	theorem heldIn_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) (o : Holder) :
178	    heldIn P' (π.f q) (o.ren π) ↔ heldIn P q o := by
179	  cases o with
180	  | frame f => exact Iff.rfl
181	  | place r => exact partOf_ren hP hd hd' r q
182	
183	/-- The move of a holder by `transfer` is equivariant when `π` keeps field order (§63, `ok`
184	effect; §49, last paragraph). -/
185	theorem mvTo_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
186	    (src dst : Nat) (o : Holder) :
187	    mvTo P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) (o.ren π) = (mvTo P src dst o).ren π := by
188	  cases o with
189	  | frame f => rfl
190	  | place r => simp only [Holder.ren, mvTo, corr_ren hP hd hd' hs, Option.getD_map]
191	
192	/-! ## Places appended from a shape (§47, §71, §72) -/
193	
194	/-- The former places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph). -/
195	theorem shapeP_get_old {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
196	    (hq : q < P.length) : (shapeP P hd ls)[q]? = P[q]? :=
197	  List.getElem?_append_left hq
198	
199	/-- The appended places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph). -/
200	theorem shapeP_get_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
201	    (i : Nat) : (shapeP P hd ls)[P.length + i]? = if i < ls.length then
202	      some ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ else none := by
203	  simp only [shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
204	    List.getElem?_map]
205	  split
206	  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_range hi]; rfl
207	  · rename_i hi
208	    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by simp only [List.length_range]; omega)]; rfl
209	
210	/-- Parents of the former places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph). -/
211	theorem shapeP_parentOf_old {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
212	    (hq : q < P.length) : parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) q = parentOf P q := by
213	  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_old hq]
214	
215	/-- Parents of the appended places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph). -/
216	theorem shapeP_parentOf_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder)
217	    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (i : Nat) :
218	    parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) (P.length + i) = (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) := by
219	  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_new]
220	  split
221	  · rfl
222	  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)]; rfl
223	
224	/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps the relation, the shape not renamed (§71.1, §72.2:
225	parents and owning elements are fresh; §49, last paragraph). -/
226	theorem shapeP_ren (hP : PRel π P P') {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
227	    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) (o : Holder) :
228	    PRel π (shapeP P o ls) (shapeP P' (o.ren π) ls) where
229	  len := by simp [shapeP, hP.len]
230	  get q := by
231	    by_cases hq : q < P.length
232	    · rw [shapeP_get_old ((hP.lt_iff q).2 hq), shapeP_get_old hq, hP.get]
233	    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = P.length + i := ⟨q - P.length, by omega⟩
234	      rw [hP.fix _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _), ← hP.len, shapeP_get_new, hP.len, shapeP_get_new]
235	      split
236	      · rename_i hi
237	        have hc := hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)
238	        simp only [Option.map_some, Place.ren, Option.some.injEq, Place.mk.injEq, and_true]
239	        constructor
240	        · have h1 := hc.1
241	          revert h1
242	          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) with
243	          | none => intro; rfl
244	          | some r => intro h1; simp only [Option.map_some, hP.fix r h1.1]
245	        · have h2 := hc.2
246	          revert h2
247	          unfold shapeOwner
248	          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
249	          | none => intro; rfl
250	          | some r => intro h2; simp only [Holder.ren, hP.fix r h2.1]
251	      · rfl
252	  fix q hq := hP.fix q (Nat.le_trans (by simp [shapeP]) hq)
253	
254	/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps parent links downward (§71.1, §72.2; §49, last
255	paragraph). -/
256	theorem shapeP_down (hdP : DownP P) {o : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
257	    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) : DownP (shapeP P o ls) := by
258	  intro j p hj
259	  by_cases hq : j < P.length
260	  · rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hq] at hj; exact hdP j p hj
261	  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = P.length + i := ⟨j - P.length, by omega⟩
262	    rw [shapeP_parentOf_new] at hj
263	    have hi : i < ls.length := by
264	      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hi
265	      rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)] at hj; cases hj
266	    have hc := (hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
267	    rw [hj] at hc; exact hc.2.1
268	
269	/-- Appending places keeps field order (§63.2, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph): appended places are
270	fixed and follow the former ones. -/
271	theorem shapeP_sib (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) {o : Holder}
272	    {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} : SibMono π (shapeP P o ls) := by
273	  intro x y p hx hy hxy
274	  by_cases hyP : y < P.length
275	  · have hxP : x < P.length := by omega
276	    rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hxP] at hx; rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hyP] at hy
277	    exact hs x y p hx hy hxy
278	  · rw [hP.fix y (by omega)]
279	    by_cases hxP : x < P.length
280	    · have := (hP.lt_iff x).2 hxP; rw [hP.len] at this; omega
281	    · rw [hP.fix x (by omega)]; exact hxy
282

3	/-!
4	# Renaming of identities: derived notions of a state
5	
6	Equivariance of the state-level notions of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` read by
7	the operations O1–O16 and by the invariants, under related states (§38; §49, last paragraph): the
8	current frame (§39), origin chains and effective anchors (§42, §44), activity (§42), usability,
9	frames of places and live holders (§40, §49.8), effective modes (§43), exercise and the
10	grounding of a right (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3), dependencies (§44), anchor order (§44, §54),
11	dynamic pinning (§74) and leaves of usable places (§66.1).
12	
13	Iff lemmas are proved in one direction and closed by symmetry (`SRel.symm`).
14	-/
15	
16	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename
17	
18	variable {π α : Ren} {s s' : S3}
19	
20	/-! ## Frames, origins, activity (§39, §42, §44) -/
21	
22	/-- The current frame is kept (§39; §49, last paragraph). -/
23	theorem SRel.top (h : SRel π α s s') : s'.top = s.top := by
24	  unfold S3.top; rw [h.F]
25	
26	/-- Origin links correspond (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
27	theorem SRel.org (h : SRel π α s s') (j : Nat) : s'.org (α.f j) = (s.org j).map α.f := by
28	  simp only [S3.org]
29	  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
30	  | none => rw [(h.A_none j).1 hy]; rfl
31	  | some y =>
32	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
33	    rw [hy', Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, hr.origin]
34	
35	/-- Origin chains correspond (§42, §43; §49, last paragraph). -/
36	theorem SRel.ancs (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (j : Nat) :
37	    s'.ancs (α.f j) = (s.ancs j).map α.f :=
38	  chain_ren hd.2 hd'.2 h.org j
39	
40	/-- Membership in origin chains is invariant (§42, §43; §49, last paragraph). -/
41	theorem SRel.mem_ancs (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (i j : Nat) :
42	    α.f j ∈ s'.ancs (α.f i) ↔ j ∈ s.ancs i := by
43	  rw [h.ancs hd hd', α.mem_map_f]
44	
45	/-- Effective anchors correspond (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
46	theorem SRel.effAnchor (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (x : Nat) :
47	    s'.effAnchor (α.f x) = α.f (s.effAnchor x) := by
48	  unfold S3.effAnchor; rw [h.ancs hd hd', List.getLastD_map]
49	
50	/-- Activity is invariant (§42, §44; §49, last paragraph). -/
51	theorem SRel.active (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : s'.Active (α.f x) ↔ s.Active x := by
52	  constructor
53	  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩
54	    obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
55	    exact ⟨y, hy, by rw [← hr.active]; exact ha⟩
56	  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩
57	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
58	    exact ⟨y', hy', by rw [hr.active]; exact ha⟩
59	
60	/-- Anchor membership is invariant (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
61	theorem SRel.mem_D (h : SRel π α s s') (q x : Nat) : α.f x ∈ s'.D (π.f q) ↔ x ∈ s.D q :=
62	  (h.D q).mem_iff.trans (α.mem_map_f _ _)
63	
64	/-- Footprint membership is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
65	theorem SRel.mem_footprint (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (l q : Nat) :
66	    π.f l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f q) ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q :=
67	  mem_footprint_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 l q
68	
69	/-- Footprints correspond up to permutation (§40, §42: a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
70	theorem SRel.footprint_perm (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (q : Nat) :
71	    (footprint s'.P (π.f q)).Perm ((footprint s.P q).map π.f) :=
72	  footprint_perm_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 q
73	
74	/-! ## Usability, frames of places, live holders (§40, §49.8) -/
75	
76	/-- `Usable` is preserved forward (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
77	theorem SRel.usable_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q) : s'.Usable (π.f q) := by
78	  induction hq with
79	  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
80	    rename_i f _
81	    exact .frame (f := f) (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)
82	      (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) (by rw [h.F]; exact hf)
83	  | place hpl hd ho _ ih =>
84	    exact .place (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)
85	      (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih
86	
87	/-- `Usable` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
88	theorem SRel.usable (h : SRel π α s s') (q : Nat) : s'.Usable (π.f q) ↔ s.Usable q :=
89	  ⟨fun hq => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.usable_of hq, h.usable_of⟩
90	
91	/-- Live holders are invariant (§49.8; §49, last paragraph). -/
92	theorem SRel.holderLive (h : SRel π α s s') (o : Holder) :
93	    HolderLive s' (o.ren π) ↔ HolderLive s o := by
94	  cases o with
95	  | frame f => show f ∈ s'.F ↔ f ∈ s.F; rw [h.F]
96	  | place p => exact h.usable p
97	
98	/-- `FrameOf` is preserved forward (§40, `placeFrame`; §49, last paragraph). -/
99	theorem SRel.frameOf_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q f : Nat} (hq : FrameOf s q f) :
100	    FrameOf s' (π.f q) f := by
101	  induction hq with
102	  | frame hpl ho =>
103	    exact .frame (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren])
104	  | place hpl ho _ ih =>
105	    exact .place (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih
106	
107	/-- `FrameOf` is invariant; frames are not renamed (§40, `placeFrame`; §49, last paragraph). -/
108	theorem SRel.frameOf (h : SRel π α s s') (q f : Nat) : FrameOf s' (π.f q) f ↔ FrameOf s q f :=
109	  ⟨fun hq => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.frameOf_of hq, h.frameOf_of⟩
110	
111	/-- `placeFrame` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
112	theorem SRel.pframe (h : SRel π α s s') (q : Nat) : s'.pframe (π.f q) = s.pframe q :=
113	  Option.ext fun f => by rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff, h.frameOf]
114	
115	/-- The frame of a holder is invariant (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
116	theorem SRel.hframe (h : SRel π α s s') (o : Holder) : s'.hframe (o.ren π) = s.hframe o := by
117	  cases o with
118	  | frame f => rfl
119	  | place p => exact h.pframe p
120	
121	/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/
122	
123	/-- Modes of covering active descendants are invariant as a set (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
124	theorem SRel.mem_descModes (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a p : Nat)
125	    (m : Mode) : m ∈ descModes s' (α.f a) (π.f p) ↔ m ∈ descModes s a p := by
126	  simp only [Access.mem_descModes]
127	  constructor
128	  · rintro ⟨j, y', hy', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
129	    rw [← α.fg j] at hy' h3
130	    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyy⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
131	    refine ⟨α.g j, y, hy, hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).1 h2,
132	      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).1 h3, hyy.mode ▸ h4⟩
133	  · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
134	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy⟩ := h.A_some hy
135	    exact ⟨α.f j, y', hy', hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).2 h2,
136	      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).2 h3, hyy.mode.symm ▸ h4⟩
137	
138	/-- `effOf` reads its list of modes as a set (§43, cases 2–4; §49, last paragraph). -/
139	theorem effOf_congr {m : Mode} {ds ds' : List Mode} (h : ∀ x, x ∈ ds ↔ x ∈ ds') :
140	    effOf m ds = effOf m ds' := by
141	  have h0 : ds = [] ↔ ds' = [] := by simp only [List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem, h]
142	  simp only [effOf, h0, h Mode.modify]
143	
144	/-- Effective modes are invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
145	theorem SRel.effective (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a p : Nat) :
146	    effective s' (α.f a) (π.f p) = effective s a p := by
147	  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
148	  | none => simp only [Access.effective, hy, (h.A_none a).1 hy]
149	  | some y =>
150	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
151	    simp only [Access.effective, hy, hy', hr.active, hr.mem_footprint, hr.mode,
152	      effOf_congr (h.mem_descModes hd hd' a p)]
153	
154	/-- Footprints of authorities correspond up to permutation (§42: a set; §49, last
155	paragraph). -/
156	theorem SRel.afp (h : SRel π α s s') (a : Nat) : (s'.afp (α.f a)).Perm ((s.afp a).map π.f) := by
157	  unfold S3.afp
158	  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
159	  | none => rw [(h.A_none a).1 hy]; exact .nil
160	  | some y =>
161	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
162	    rw [hy']; exact hr.footprint
163	
164	/-- Footprint membership of authorities is invariant (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
165	theorem SRel.mem_afp (h : SRel π α s s') (a l : Nat) : π.f l ∈ s'.afp (α.f a) ↔ l ∈ s.afp a :=
166	  (h.afp a).mem_iff.trans (π.mem_map_f _ _)
167	
168	/-- Sufficient effective mode over a footprint is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
169	theorem SRel.forall_footprint_allows (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
170	    (q a : Nat) (m : Mode) :
171	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f q), Allows (Access.effective s' (α.f a) l) m) ↔
172	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (Access.effective s a l) m :=
173	  π.forall_mem_iff (fun l => h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q)
174	    (fun l => by rw [h.effective hd hd'])
175	
176	/-! ## Exercise and rights (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3) -/
177	
178	/-- `ExercisableAt` is preserved forward (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
179	theorem SRel.exercisableAt_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') {a : Nat}
180	    {m : Mode} (he : s.ExercisableAt a m) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m := by
181	  induction he with
182	  | base hy ha hm hf =>
183	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
184	    exact .base hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
185	      (by rw [hr.holder, hf, h.top]; rfl)
186	  | held hy ha hm hp _ hc ih =>
187	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
188	    exact .held hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
189	      (by rw [hr.holder, hp]; rfl) ih ((h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' _ _ _).2 hc)
190	
191	/-- `ExercisableAt` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
192	theorem SRel.exercisableAt (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a : Nat)
193	    (m : Mode) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m ↔ s.ExercisableAt a m :=
194	  ⟨fun he => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, α.gf] using h.symm.exercisableAt_of hd' hd he,
195	   h.exercisableAt_of hd hd'⟩
196	
197	/-- `HasRight` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
198	theorem SRel.hasRight (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (m : Mode) (q : Nat) :
199	    HasRight s' m (π.f q) ↔ HasRight s m q :=
200	  α.exists_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun a =>
201	    and_congr (h.exercisableAt hd hd' a m) (h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' q a m)
202	
203	/-- `Grounds` is invariant (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
204	theorem SRel.grounds (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) :
205	    Grounds s' m (π.f q) (α.f g) ↔ Grounds s m q g :=
206	  and_congr (h.mem_rangeA g)
207	    (and_congr (h.exercisableAt hd hd' g m) (h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' q g m))
208	
209	/-- `RightChain` is invariant (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
210	theorem SRel.rightChain (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (g j : Nat) :
211	    RightChain s' (α.f g) (α.f j) ↔ RightChain s g j :=
212	  or_congr α.f_inj (h.mem_ancs hd hd' g j)
213	
214	/-! ## Dependencies and anchor order (§44, §54) -/
215	
216	/-- Anchors gathered over the places selected by corresponding predicates correspond up to
217	permutation (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §63, `ok` effect; §49, last paragraph). -/
218	theorem SRel.filter_flatMap_D (h : SRel π α s s') {Q Q' : Nat → Bool}
219	    (hQ : ∀ r, Q' (π.f r) = Q r) :
220	    (((List.range s'.P.length).filter Q').flatMap s'.D).Perm
221	      ((((List.range s.P.length).filter Q).flatMap s.D).map α.f) := by
222	  have hL : ((List.range s'.P.length).filter Q').Perm
223	      (((List.range s.P.length).filter Q).map π.f) :=
224	    π.perm_of_mem (List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range)
225	      (List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range) fun r => by
226	        simp only [List.mem_filter, h.P.mem_range, hQ]
227	  refine (hL.flatMap_right s'.D).trans ?_
228	  rw [List.flatMap_map, List.map_flatMap]
229	  exact perm_flatMap_pointwise fun r _ => h.D r
230	
231	/-- Inherited anchors correspond up to permutation (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
232	theorem SRel.depsOf (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (q : Nat) :
233	    (Access.depsOf s' (π.f q)).Perm ((Access.depsOf s q).map α.f) :=
234	  h.filter_flatMap_D fun r => decide_eq_decide.2 (partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 r q)
235	
236	/-- `DepsValid` is invariant (§44; §66.3, §67.3, §68.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
237	theorem SRel.depsValid (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (p : Nat) :
238	    DepsValid s' (π.f p) ↔ DepsValid s p :=
239	  π.forall_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q => by
240	    rw [partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1]
241	    exact imp_congr_right fun _ => α.forall_mem_iff (h.mem_D q) h.active
242	
243	/-- `EffAnchorOK` is invariant; frames are not renamed (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
244	theorem SRel.effAnchorOK (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (x : Nat)
245	    (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOK s' (α.f x) fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
246	  unfold EffAnchorOK
247	  rw [h.effAnchor hd hd']
248	  cases hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? with
249	  | none => rw [(h.A_none _).1 hz]; exact Iff.rfl
250	  | some z =>
251	    obtain ⟨z', hz', hr⟩ := h.A_some hz
252	    rw [hz']
253	    simp only [OptP, hr.holder, h.hframe, h.F]
254	
255	/-- `AnchorOrder` is preserved forward (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
256	theorem SRel.anchorOrder_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
257	    (ha : AnchorOrder s) : AnchorOrder s' := by
258	  intro q' hq' x' hx'
259	  rw [← π.fg q'] at hq' hx' ⊢
260	  rw [← α.fg x'] at hx' ⊢
261	  rw [h.pframe, h.effAnchorOK hd hd']
262	  exact ha _ ((h.usable _).1 hq') _ ((h.mem_D _ _).1 hx')
263	
264	/-- `AnchorOrder` is invariant (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
265	theorem SRel.anchorOrder (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') :
266	    AnchorOrder s' ↔ AnchorOrder s :=
267	  ⟨h.symm.anchorOrder_of hd' hd, h.anchorOrder_of hd hd'⟩
268	
269	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` is preserved forward (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
270	theorem SRel.anchorOrderHeld_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
271	    (ha : AnchorOrderHeld s) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
272	  intro q' hq' x' y' hy' ya hh
273	  rw [← π.fg q'] at hq' hh ⊢
274	  rw [← α.fg x'] at hy' ⊢
275	  obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
276	  rw [h.pframe, h.effAnchorOK hd hd']
277	  rw [hr.holder] at hh
278	  exact ha _ ((h.usable _).1 hq') _ y hy (by rw [← hr.active]; exact ya)
279	    ((Holder.ren_inj π (b := .place (π.g q'))).1 hh)
280	
281	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` is invariant (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
282	theorem SRel.anchorOrderHeld (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') :
283	    AnchorOrderHeld s' ↔ AnchorOrderHeld s :=
284	  ⟨h.symm.anchorOrderHeld_of hd' hd, h.anchorOrderHeld_of hd hd'⟩
285	
286	/-! ## Dynamic pinning, leaves of usable places (§74, §66.1) -/
287	
288	/-- Dynamic pinning is invariant (§74; §49, last paragraph). -/
289	theorem SRel.pin (h : SRel π α s s') (l : Nat) : s'.pin (π.f l) = s.pin l := by
290	  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, S3.pin_iff, S3.pin_iff]
291	  constructor
292	  · rintro ⟨i, ob', hob', ha, hl⟩
293	    obtain ⟨ob, hob, hr⟩ := h.pins_some' hob'
294	    exact ⟨i, ob, hob, by rw [← hr.active]; exact ha, (hr.mem_leaves l).1 hl⟩
295	  · rintro ⟨i, ob, hob, ha, hl⟩
296	    obtain ⟨ob', hob', hr⟩ := h.pins_some hob
297	    exact ⟨i, ob', hob', by rw [hr.active]; exact ha, (hr.mem_leaves l).2 hl⟩
298	
299	/-- `LeafOfUsable` is invariant (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1; §49, last paragraph). -/
300	theorem SRel.leafOfUsable (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (l : Nat) :
301	    LeafOfUsable s' (π.f l) ↔ LeafOfUsable s l :=
302	  π.exists_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q => and_congr (h.usable q) (h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q)
303

3	/-!
4	# Renaming of identities: places
5	
6	Equivariance of the place-level notions of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` under a
7	renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): parent chains, parts, leaves and footprints (§40),
8	overlap (§63.3), transitive ownership (§40), root places (§40), released units (§70), children,
9	positional correspondence and same shape (§63.2), holders within a value and their move (§63),
10	and the places appended from a shape (§47, §71, §72).
11	-/
12	
13	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename
14	
15	variable {π : Ren} {P P' : List Place}
16	
17	/-- A renamed option is a renamed `some` exactly when the option is that `some` (§49, last
18	paragraph). -/
19	theorem Ren.option_map_eq_some (π : Ren) (o : Option Nat) (x : Nat) :
20	    o.map π.f = some (π.f x) ↔ o = some x := by
21	  cases o <;> simp [Ren.f_inj]
22	
23	/-! ## Chains, parts, leaves, footprints (§40) -/
24	
25	/-- Chains along links related by an injective map, both downward, correspond (§40 parents, §42
26	origins; §49, last paragraph). -/
27	theorem chain_ren {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
28	    (hd : ∀ j o, org j = some o → o < j) (hd' : ∀ j o, org' j = some o → o < j)
29	    (h : ∀ j, org' (f j) = (org j).map f) : ∀ i, chain org' (f i) = (chain org i).map f := by
30	  intro i
31	  induction i using Nat.strongRecOn with
32	  | _ i ih =>
33	    cases ho : org i with
34	    | none => rw [chain_none ho, chain_none (by rw [h, ho]; rfl)]; rfl
35	    | some o =>
36	      have h' : org' (f i) = some (f o) := by rw [h, ho]; rfl
37	      rw [chain_cons ho (hd _ _ ho), chain_cons h' (hd' _ _ h'), ih o (hd _ _ ho)]
38	      rfl
39	
40	/-- Structural parents of related place lists correspond (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
41	theorem PRel.parentOf (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) :
42	    parentOf P' (π.f q) = (parentOf P q).map π.f := by
43	  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, hP.get]
44	  cases P[q]? <;> simp [Place.ren]
45	
46	/-- A renamed place has the renamed parent exactly when the place has that parent (§40; §49,
47	last paragraph). -/
48	theorem PRel.parentOf_eq_some (hP : PRel π P P') (q p : Nat) :
49	    Access.parentOf P' (π.f q) = some (π.f p) ↔ Access.parentOf P q = some p := by
50	  rw [hP.parentOf, π.option_map_eq_some]
51

53	theorem chainP_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) :

59	    partOf P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ partOf P p q := by
60	  simp only [partOf, hP.lt_iff, chainP_ren hP hd hd', π.mem_map_f, Ren.f_inj]

63	theorem isLeaf_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (l : Nat) : isLeaf P' (π.f l) ↔ isLeaf P l := by
64	  unfold isLeaf
65	  refine π.forall_iff fun r => ?_

79	    (footprint P' (π.f q)).Perm ((footprint P q).map π.f) :=

87	    (fun x => mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' x q)

93	    (h : OwnedIn P src q) : OwnedIn P' (π.f src) (π.f q) := by

96	    exact .direct (by rw [hP.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren])
97	      ((partOf_ren hP hd hd' _ _).2 hp)
98	  | step hpl ho _ ih =>
99	    exact .step (by rw [hP.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih

103	    OwnedIn P' (π.f src) (π.f q) ↔ OwnedIn P src q :=
104	  ⟨fun h => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using ownedIn_ren_of hP.symm hd' hd h,
105	   ownedIn_ren_of hP hd hd'⟩

109	  simp only [RootPlace, hP.lt_iff, hP.parentOf, Option.map_eq_none_iff]

114	  simp only [FreedPlace, partOf_ren hP hd hd', ownedIn_ren hP hd hd']

119	theorem kids_sorted (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : (kids P x).Pairwise (· < ·) :=
120	  List.pairwise_lt_range.filter _
121	
122	/-- Children correspond in order when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
123	theorem kids_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) (x : Nat) :
124	    kids P' (π.f x) = (kids P x).map π.f := by
125	  apply eq_of_sorted_mem (kids_sorted P' _)
126	  · rw [List.pairwise_map]
127	    refine (kids_sorted P x).imp_of_mem fun {a b} ha hb hab => ?_
128	    exact hs a b x (mem_kids.1 ha).2 (mem_kids.1 hb).2 hab
129	  · intro a
130	    rw [← π.fg a, π.mem_map_f, mem_kids, mem_kids, hP.lt_iff, hP.parentOf_eq_some]
131	
132	/-- `corr` of a part without parent other than `src` is undefined (§63.2; §49, last
133	paragraph). -/
134	theorem corr_none {src dst r : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src) (hp : parentOf P r = none) :
135	    corr P src dst r = none := by
136	  unfold corr; cases r <;> simp [corrF, hr, hp]
137	
138	/-- `corr` is equivariant when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
139	theorem corr_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
140	    (src dst : Nat) : ∀ r, corr P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) (π.f r) = (corr P src dst r).map π.f := by
141	  intro r
142	  induction r using Nat.strongRecOn with
143	  | _ r ih =>
144	    by_cases hr : r = src
145	    · subst hr; rw [corr_src, corr_src]; rfl
146	    · have hr' : π.f r ≠ π.f src := fun e => hr ((Ren.f_inj π).1 e)
147	      cases hp : parentOf P r with
148	      | none =>
149	        rw [corr_none hr hp, corr_none hr' (by rw [hP.parentOf, hp]; rfl)]; rfl
150	      | some p =>
151	        have hp' : parentOf P' (π.f r) = some (π.f p) := by rw [hP.parentOf, hp]; rfl
152	        rw [corr_step hr hp (hd _ _ hp), corr_step hr' hp' (hd' _ _ hp'), ih p (hd _ _ hp),
153	          kids_ren hP hs p, posIn_map (fun _ _ e => (Ren.f_inj π).1 e)]
154	        cases corr P src dst p with
155	        | none => rfl
156	        | some p0 =>
157	          simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, kids_ren hP hs p0, List.getElem?_map]

162	  unfold SameShape
163	  refine and_congr (π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun r => ?_)
164	    (π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun z => ?_)
165	  · rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd', corr_ren hP hd hd' hs]
166	    refine imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
167	    cases corr P src dst r with
168	    | none => exact Iff.rfl
169	    | some c => simp only [Option.map_some, OptP, kids_ren hP hs, List.length_map]
170	  · rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd']
171	    refine imp_congr_right fun _ => π.exists_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun r => ?_
172	    rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd', corr_ren hP hd hd' hs, π.option_map_eq_some]

178	    heldIn P' (π.f q) (o.ren π) ↔ heldIn P q o := by

180	  | frame f => exact Iff.rfl

186	    (src dst : Nat) (o : Holder) :

189	  | frame f => rfl
190	  | place r => simp only [Holder.ren, mvTo, corr_ren hP hd hd' hs, Option.getD_map]

193	
194	/-- The former places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph). -/
195	theorem shapeP_get_old {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
196	    (hq : q < P.length) : (shapeP P hd ls)[q]? = P[q]? :=
197	  List.getElem?_append_left hq
198	
199	/-- The appended places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph). -/
200	theorem shapeP_get_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
201	    (i : Nat) : (shapeP P hd ls)[P.length + i]? = if i < ls.length then
202	      some ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ else none := by
203	  simp only [shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
204	    List.getElem?_map]
205	  split
206	  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_range hi]; rfl
207	  · rename_i hi
208	    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by simp only [List.length_range]; omega)]; rfl

212	    (hq : q < P.length) : parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) q = parentOf P q := by
213	  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_old hq]

216	theorem shapeP_parentOf_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder)
217	    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (i : Nat) :
218	    parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) (P.length + i) = (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) := by
219	  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_new]
220	  split
221	  · rfl
222	  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)]; rfl
223	
224	/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps the relation, the shape not renamed (§71.1, §72.2:
225	parents and owning elements are fresh; §49, last paragraph). -/
226	theorem shapeP_ren (hP : PRel π P P') {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
227	    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) (o : Holder) :
228	    PRel π (shapeP P o ls) (shapeP P' (o.ren π) ls) where
229	  len := by simp [shapeP, hP.len]
230	  get q := by
231	    by_cases hq : q < P.length
232	    · rw [shapeP_get_old ((hP.lt_iff q).2 hq), shapeP_get_old hq, hP.get]
233	    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = P.length + i := ⟨q - P.length, by omega⟩
234	      rw [hP.fix _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _), ← hP.len, shapeP_get_new, hP.len, shapeP_get_new]
235	      split
236	      · rename_i hi
237	        have hc := hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)
238	        simp only [Option.map_some, Place.ren, Option.some.injEq, Place.mk.injEq, and_true]
239	        constructor
240	        · have h1 := hc.1
241	          revert h1
242	          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) with
243	          | none => intro; rfl
244	          | some r => intro h1; simp only [Option.map_some, hP.fix r h1.1]
245	        · have h2 := hc.2
246	          revert h2
247	          unfold shapeOwner
248	          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
249	          | none => intro; rfl
250	          | some r => intro h2; simp only [Holder.ren, hP.fix r h2.1]
251	      · rfl
252	  fix q hq := hP.fix q (Nat.le_trans (by simp [shapeP]) hq)
253	
254	/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps parent links downward (§71.1, §72.2; §49, last
255	paragraph). -/
256	theorem shapeP_down (hdP : DownP P) {o : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
257	    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) : DownP (shapeP P o ls) := by
258	  intro j p hj
259	  by_cases hq : j < P.length
260	  · rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hq] at hj; exact hdP j p hj
261	  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = P.length + i := ⟨j - P.length, by omega⟩
262	    rw [shapeP_parentOf_new] at hj
263	    have hi : i < ls.length := by
264	      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hi
265	      rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)] at hj; cases hj
266	    have hc := (hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
267	    rw [hj] at hc; exact hc.2.1
268	
269	/-- Appending places keeps field order (§63.2, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph): appended places are
270	fixed and follow the former ones. -/

272	    {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} : SibMono π (shapeP P o ls) := by
273	  intro x y p hx hy hxy
274	  by_cases hyP : y < P.length
275	  · have hxP : x < P.length := by omega
276	    rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hxP] at hx; rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hyP] at hy
277	    exact hs x y p hx hy hxy
278	  · rw [hP.fix y (by omega)]
279	    by_cases hxP : x < P.length
280	    · have := (hP.lt_iff x).2 hxP; rw [hP.len] at this; omega
281	    · rw [hP.fix x (by omega)]; exact hxy
282	
283	end Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

388	/-- Related place lists have related bounds (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
389	theorem PRel.lt_iff (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) : π.f q < P'.length ↔ q < P.length := by
390	  have := hP.get q
391	  constructor
392	  · intro hq
393	    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hq] at this
394	    cases e : P[q]? with
395	    | none => rw [e] at this; cases this
396	    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 e).1
397	  · intro hq
398	    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hq] at this
399	    cases e : P'[π.f q]? with
400	    | none => rw [e] at this; cases this
401	    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 e).1
402	
403	/-- Membership in the place range, renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
404	theorem PRel.mem_range (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) :
405	    π.f q ∈ List.range P'.length ↔ q ∈ List.range P.length := by
406	  simp only [List.mem_range, hP.lt_iff]
407	
408	/-- Universal quantification over the places, renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
409	theorem PRel.forall_range (hP : PRel π P P') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
410	    (∀ y ∈ List.range P'.length, Q y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ List.range P.length, Q (π.f x) :=
411	  π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun _ => Iff.rfl
412	
413	/-- Existential quantification over the places, renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
414	theorem PRel.exists_range (hP : PRel π P P') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
415	    (∃ y ∈ List.range P'.length, Q y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ List.range P.length, Q (π.f x) :=
416	  π.exists_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun _ => Iff.rfl
417	
418	/-- Symmetry of related place lists (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
419	theorem PRel.symm (hP : PRel π P P') : PRel π.symm P' P where
420	  len := hP.len.symm
421	  get q := by
422	    have := hP.get (π.g q)
423	    rw [π.fg] at this
424	    rw [Ren.symm_f, this, Option.map_map]
425	    cases P[π.g q]? <;> simp [Function.comp_def, Place.ren_symm]
426	  fix q hq := by
427	    have := hP.fix q (hP.len ▸ hq)
428	    show π.g q = q
429	    conv => lhs; rw [← this]
430	    exact π.gf q
431	
432	/-- Transitivity of related place lists (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
433	theorem PRel.trans (hP : PRel π P P') (hP' : PRel π' P' P'') : PRel (π'.comp π) P P'' where
434	  len := hP'.len.trans hP.len
435	  get q := by
436	    show P''[π'.f (π.f q)]? = _
437	    rw [hP'.get, hP.get, Option.map_map]
438	    congr 1; funext pl; exact Place.ren_comp π π' pl
439	  fix q hq := by
440	    show π'.f (π.f q) = q
441	    rw [hP.fix q hq, hP'.fix q (hP.len ▸ hq)]
442	
443	/-- Authorities related: footprint membership (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
444	theorem AuthRel.mem_footprint {y y' : Authority} (hr : AuthRel π α y y') (l : Nat) :
445	    π.f l ∈ y'.footprint ↔ l ∈ y.footprint :=
446	  hr.footprint.mem_iff.trans (π.mem_map_f _ _)

448	/-- Symmetry of related authorities (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
449	theorem AuthRel.symm {y y' : Authority} (h : AuthRel π α y y') : AuthRel π.symm α.symm y' y where
450	  mode := h.mode.symm
451	  origin := by rw [h.origin, Option.map_map]; cases y.origin <;> simp [α.gf]
452	  footprint := by
453	    have := h.footprint.map π.g
454	    rw [Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
455	  holder := by rw [h.holder, Holder.ren_symm]
456	  active := h.active.symm

458	/-- Transitivity of related authorities (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
459	theorem AuthRel.trans {y y' y'' : Authority} (h : AuthRel π α y y') (h' : AuthRel π' α' y' y'') :
460	    AuthRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α) y y'' where
461	  mode := h'.mode.trans h.mode
462	  origin := by rw [h'.origin, h.origin, Option.map_map]; rfl
463	  footprint := h'.footprint.trans ((h.footprint.map π'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
464	  holder := by rw [h'.holder, h.holder, Holder.ren_comp]
465	  active := h'.active.trans h.active

467	/-- Related obligations: leaf membership (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
468	theorem PinRel.mem_leaves {ob ob' : PinOb} (hr : PinRel π ob ob') (l : Nat) :
469	    π.f l ∈ ob'.leaves ↔ l ∈ ob.leaves :=
470	  hr.leaves.mem_iff.trans (π.mem_map_f _ _)
471	
472	/-- Symmetry of related obligations (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
473	theorem PinRel.symm {ob ob' : PinOb} (h : PinRel π ob ob') : PinRel π.symm ob' ob where
474	  place := by rw [h.place]; exact (π.gf _).symm
475	  leaves := by have := h.leaves.map π.g; rw [Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
476	  active := h.active.symm
477	
478	/-- Transitivity of related obligations (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
479	theorem PinRel.trans {ob ob' ob'' : PinOb} (h : PinRel π ob ob') (h' : PinRel π' ob' ob'') :
480	    PinRel (π'.comp π) ob ob'' where
481	  place := by rw [h'.place, h.place]; rfl
482	  leaves := h'.leaves.trans ((h.leaves.map π'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
483	  active := h'.active.trans h.active

485	/-- Symmetry of related states (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
486	theorem SRel.symm (h : SRel π α s s') : SRel π.symm α.symm s' s where
487	  F := h.F.symm
488	  nF := h.nF.symm
489	  P := h.P.symm
490	  I l := by have := h.I (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
491	  Alen := h.Alen.symm
492	  A x := by
493	    have := optionRel_symm (fun _ _ hy => AuthRel.symm hy) (h.A (α.g x))
494	    rw [α.fg] at this; exact this
495	  Afix x hx := by
496	    have := h.Afix x (h.Alen ▸ hx)
497	    show α.g x = x
498	    conv => lhs; rw [← this]
499	    exact α.gf x
500	  D q := by
501	    have := (h.D (π.g q)).map α.g
502	    rw [π.fg, Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
503	  dead q := by have := h.dead (π.g q); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
504	  pins o := optionRel_symm (fun _ _ hy => PinRel.symm hy) (h.pins o)
505	
506	/-- Transitivity of related states (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
507	theorem SRel.trans (h : SRel π α s s') (h' : SRel π' α' s' s'') :
508	    SRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α) s s'' where
509	  F := h'.F.trans h.F
510	  nF := h'.nF.trans h.nF
511	  P := h.P.trans h'.P
512	  I l := (h'.I (π.f l)).trans (h.I l)
513	  Alen := h'.Alen.trans h.Alen
514	  A x := optionRel_trans (r := AuthRel π α) (r' := AuthRel π' α')
515	    (r'' := AuthRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α))
516	    (fun _ _ _ hy hy' => AuthRel.trans hy hy') (h.A x) (h'.A (α.f x))
517	  Afix x hx := by
518	    show α'.f (α.f x) = x
519	    rw [h.Afix x hx, h'.Afix x (h.Alen ▸ hx)]
520	  D q := (h'.D (π.f q)).trans (((h.D q).map α'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
521	  dead q := (h'.dead (π.f q)).trans (h.dead q)
522	  pins o := optionRel_trans (r := PinRel π) (r' := PinRel π') (r'' := PinRel (π'.comp π))
523	    (fun _ _ _ hy hy' => PinRel.trans hy hy') (h.pins o) (h'.pins o)

532	theorem SRel.A_some (h : SRel π α s s') {x : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) :

541	/-- Authorities are absent together (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
542	theorem SRel.A_none (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : s.A[x]? = none ↔ s'.A[α.f x]? = none :=

546	theorem SRel.pins_some (h : SRel π α s s') {o : Nat} {ob : PinOb} (hob : s.pins[o]? = some ob) :
547	    ∃ ob', s'.pins[o]? = some ob' ∧ PinRel π ob ob' :=
548	  optionRel_some (h.pins o) hob

550	/-- An existing obligation of the related state has a related obligation (§74, §75; §49, last
551	paragraph). -/
552	theorem SRel.pins_some' (h : SRel π α s s') {o : Nat} {ob' : PinOb}
553	    (hob : s'.pins[o]? = some ob') : ∃ ob, s.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ PinRel π ob ob' :=
554	  optionRel_some' (h.pins o) hob

556	/-- Obligations are absent together (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
557	theorem SRel.pins_none (h : SRel π α s s') (o : Nat) : s.pins[o]? = none ↔ s'.pins[o]? = none :=
558	  optionRel_none_iff (h.pins o)

560	/-- Related states have related authority bounds (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
561	theorem SRel.Alt (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : α.f x < s'.A.length ↔ x < s.A.length := by
562	  have := h.A_none x
563	  rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff] at this
564	  omega

566	/-- Membership in the authority range, renamed (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
567	theorem SRel.mem_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) :
568	    α.f x ∈ List.range s'.A.length ↔ x ∈ List.range s.A.length := by
569	  simp only [List.mem_range, h.Alt]
570	
571	/-- Universal quantification over the authorities, renamed (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
572	theorem SRel.forall_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
573	    (∀ y ∈ List.range s'.A.length, Q y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, Q (α.f x) :=
574	  α.forall_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun _ => Iff.rfl
575	
576	/-- Existential quantification over the authorities, renamed (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
577	theorem SRel.exists_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
578	    (∃ y ∈ List.range s'.A.length, Q y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, Q (α.f x) :=
