581	/-- `WF3` gives downward links (§49.2, §49.5; §49, last paragraph). -/
582	theorem Down.of_wf3 (hw : WF3 s) : Down s := by
583	  refine ⟨fun _ _ hp => (hw.parent_lt hp).1, fun j o ho => ?_⟩
584	  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyo⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 ho
585	  exact hw.origins j y o hy hyo

587	/-- Field order kept by `π` is kept by its inverse on the related list (§63.2; §49, last
588	paragraph). -/
589	theorem SibMono.symm (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) : SibMono π.symm P' := by
590	  have hpar : ∀ x p, parentOf P' x = some p → parentOf P (π.g x) = some (π.g p) := by
591	    intro x p hx
592	    have := hP.get (π.g x)
593	    rw [π.fg] at this
594	    simp only [parentOf, this] at hx ⊢
595	    cases e : P[π.g x]? with
596	    | none => rw [e] at hx; cases hx
597	    | some pl =>
598	      rw [e] at hx
599	      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, Place.ren] at hx
600	      cases hpp : pl.parent with
601	      | none => rw [hpp] at hx; cases hx
602	      | some r =>
603	        rw [hpp] at hx; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hx
604	        simp only [Option.bind_some, hpp, ← hx, π.gf]
605	  intro x y p hx hy hxy
606	  simp only [Ren.symm_f]
607	  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy (π.g x) (π.g y) with hlt | heq | hgt
608	  · exact hlt
609	  · exact absurd ((by rw [← π.fg x, heq, π.fg] : x = y) ▸ hxy) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
610	  · have := hs _ _ _ (hpar y p hy) (hpar x p hx) hgt
611	    rw [π.fg, π.fg] at this; omega
612	
613	/-- Field order depends only on the parent links (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
614	theorem SibMono.congr {P₁ : List Place} (hpar : parentOf P₁ = parentOf P) (hs : SibMono π P) :
615	    SibMono π P₁ := by
616	  intro x y p hx hy; rw [hpar] at hx hy; exact hs x y p hx hy

619	theorem Sim.symm (hS : Sim π α s s') : Sim π.symm α.symm s' s where
620	  rel := hS.rel.symm
621	  down := hS.down'
622	  down' := hS.down
623	  sib := SibMono.symm hS.rel.P hS.sib

625	/-- The renamed contract corresponds to the contract (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
626	theorem KCorr.rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : KCorr π α k (k.rename π α) where
627	  dd r r' := by simp only [K.rename, Ren.map_gf]
628	  shared l := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
629	  pinned l := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
630	  done _ := Iff.rfl
631	  dealloc p := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
632	  compat p a := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
633	
634	/-- Symmetry of corresponding contracts (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
635	theorem KCorr.symm {k k' : K} (hK : KCorr π α k k') : KCorr π.symm α.symm k' k where
636	  dd r r' := by
637	    have := hK.dd (r.map π.g) (r'.map π.g)
638	    rw [Ren.map_fg, Ren.map_fg] at this; exact this.symm
639	  shared l := by have := hK.shared (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
640	  pinned l := by have := hK.pinned (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
641	  done o := (hK.done o).symm
642	  dealloc p := by have := hK.dealloc (π.g p); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
643	  compat p a := by have := hK.compat (π.g p) a; rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
644	
645	/-- `DDSound` (§80, §23) is invariant under renaming of the contract (§49, last paragraph). -/
646	theorem ddSound_rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : DDSound (k.rename π α) ↔ DDSound k := by
647	  constructor
648	  · intro h r r' hd l hl hl'
649	    have hd' : (k.rename π α).DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.f) (r'.map π.f) := by
650	      simp only [K.rename, Ren.map_gf]; exact hd
651	    exact h _ _ hd' (π.f l) ((π.mem_map_f _ _).2 hl) ((π.mem_map_f _ _).2 hl')
652	  · intro h r r' hd l hl hl'
653	    exact h _ _ hd (π.g l) (List.mem_map_of_mem hl) (List.mem_map_of_mem hl')
654	
655	/-- Guarded steps with corresponding preconditions and related effects correspond (§58; §49, last
656	paragraph). -/
657	theorem guarded_corr {Pre Pre' : Prop} {e e' : S3} (hp : Pre' ↔ Pre)
658	    (he : Pre → SRel π α e e') : StepCorr π α (Guarded Pre e) (Guarded Pre' e') := by
659	  constructor
660	  · intro o ho
661	    cases ho with
662	    | ok hpre => exact ⟨.ok e', .ok (hp.2 hpre), he hpre⟩
663	    | reject hpre => exact ⟨.reject, .reject (fun h' => hpre (hp.1 h')), trivial⟩
664	  · intro o' ho'
665	    cases ho' with
666	    | ok hpre => exact ⟨.ok e, .ok (hp.1 hpre), he (hp.1 hpre)⟩
667	    | reject hpre => exact ⟨.reject, .reject (fun h => hpre (hp.2 h)), trivial⟩
668	
669	end
670	
671	/-- Renaming the arguments by the inverse, then by the renaming, gives the operation back (§60–§75;
672	§49, last paragraph). -/
673	theorem KernelOp.ren_symm_ren (π α : Ren) (op : KernelOp) :
674	    (op.ren π.symm α.symm).ren π α = op := by
675	  cases op <;>
676	    simp [KernelOp.ren, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.fg, α.fg]
677	
678	/-- Renaming the arguments, then by the inverse, gives the operation back (§60–§75; §49, last
679	paragraph). -/
680	theorem KernelOp.symm_ren_ren (π α : Ren) (op : KernelOp) :
681	    (op.ren π α).ren π.symm α.symm = op :=
682	  KernelOp.ren_symm_ren π.symm α.symm op
683	
684	end Rename

24	/-- `ancestor(f₁, f₂)` (§39): `f₁` is `f₂` or one of its ancestors in the stack. -/

32	
33	/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along the link `org`, nearest first, within fuel `k` (§40 structural
34	parents, §42 origins). Only links to a smaller index are followed (§49, last paragraph). -/
35	def chainF (org : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
36	  | 0, _ => []
37	  | k + 1, i =>
38	    match org i with
39	    | some o => if o < i then o :: chainF org k o else []
40	    | none => []
41	
42	/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (§40, §42); fuel `i` suffices since the chain
43	decreases. -/
44	def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i

63	def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)
64

66	ancestors. -/
67	def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
68	  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

121	
122	/-- Authority (§42): own mode, optional origin, footprint (a list of leaves read
123	extensionally), holder, activity. Its identity is its index in `A`. -/
124	structure Authority where
125	  mode : Mode
126	  origin : Option Nat
127	  footprint : List Nat
128	  holder : Holder
129	  active : Bool
130	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
131	
132	/-- Dynamic pinning obligation (§74, §75): the place `pin` was applied to, the leaves it pins, and
133	whether it is still active. Its identity is its index in `S3.pins`. -/
134	structure PinOb where
135	  place : Nat
136	  leaves : List Nat
137	  active : Bool
138	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
139	
140	/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
141	identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
142	§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
143	structure S3 where
144	  F : Frames
145	  nF : Nat
146	  P : List Place
147	  I : Nat → InitSt
148	  A : List Authority
149	  D : Nat → List Nat
150	  dead : Nat → Bool
151	  pins : List PinOb
152	
153	/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
154	def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l
155	
156	/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
157	optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
158	receiving the shape. -/
159	abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)
160	
161	/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
162	`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
163	obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
164	`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
165	fields. -/
166	structure K where
167	  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
168	  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
169	  Pinned : Nat → Prop
170	  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
171	  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
172	  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
173	  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop
174	
175	/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
176	def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'
177	
178	/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
179	def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)
180	
181	/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
182	def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i
183	
184	/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
185	`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
186	def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x
187	
188	/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
189	def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true
190	
191	/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
192	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
193	  match h : s.A[x]? with
194	  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
195	    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
196	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'
197	
198	/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
199	def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0
200	
201	/-! ## Decidable helpers -/
202	
203	/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
204	components of `S3` (§38). -/
205	def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
206	  match o with
207	  | some y => P y
208	  | none => d
209	
210	/-- Decidability of `OptP` (§38). -/
211	instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
212	    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
213	  match o with
214	  | some y => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (P y))
215	  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable d)
216	
217	/-- An index with a value is in range (§38: identities are list indices). -/
218	theorem lt_of_getElem? {α : Type} {l : List α} {i : Nat} {x : α} (h : l[i]? = some x) :
219	    i < l.length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
220	
221	/-! ## Least fixed points on a bounded universe
222	
223	`Usable` (§40), `FrameOf` (§40), `OwnedIn` (§40) and `ExercisableAt` (§43) are inductive
224	predicates, each the least fixed point of a monotone rule over identities below a bound `n`; the
225	Kleene iteration is stable after `n + 1` steps, which makes them decidable. -/
226	
227	/-- `k`-th Kleene iterate of a rule `R` on Boolean predicates over `Nat` (decision procedure for
228	§40 and §43). -/
229	def kiter (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Nat → Nat → Bool
230	  | 0, _ => false
231	  | k + 1, a => R (kiter R k) a
232	
233	/-- A monotone rule whose conclusions lie below `n` and which reads its premise only below `n`
234	(decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/

/-- A guarded transition has one outcome (§58). -/
theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- The `ok` outcome of a guarded transition: the preconditions hold and the state is the effect
(§58). -/
theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩

/-- The `reject` outcome of a guarded transition: the preconditions fail (§58). -/
theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; assumption, fun h => .reject h⟩

content.content:
- available leaves and issued regions belong to the administered storage;
- two still-active issuances have disjoint regions; no leaf of a still-issued region simultaneously belongs to `available`;
- every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal` complying with exclusivity and validity rules;
- anchor and ownership restrictions are respected.

Arena entries do not, by themselves, constitute an additional storage owner. Two live arenas may cover common leaves when their `internal` authorities are distinct and their effective rights are compatible; no **global** disjointness of arena footprints is imposed.

## 56. Uniqueness of Live Administration

**An authority identity may serve as `internal` for at most one live administrative abstraction**, whether an arena, `HandlePool`, `DataStack`, or another library administrative instance. Before registering a new abstraction, its creation operation must jointly check the absence of that identity from **all relevant registries of live administrations**. Uniqueness concerns the identity of the `internal` authority, not merely possible overlap of footprints: abstractions with distinct `internal` identities are not forbidden merely because their footprints overlap. Library contracts must make the information required for this guard available to the creation operation; checking only an abstraction's own registry is insufficient.

**This guard is not a condition for any safety property in Section 57.** The effective right (Section 43, case 3) already prohibits a second issuance over leaves covered by an active block derived from the same authority. Rather, the guard preserves the **abstraction contract**: without it, simultaneous administration of the same `internal` could cause `reject` instead of `fail`, or reissue a previously released block that the first administration still considers unavailable. It creates neither permissions nor allocations and introduces no general detection of authority cycles. Its physical representation and encapsulation of library registries remain outside the kernel.

## 57. Main Invariant

\[
Inv3 = I1 \land I2 \land I3 \land I4 \land AnchorOrder \land NoDangling
\]

On states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`, the kernel guarantees:

\[
WF3 \land Inv3 \land AnchorOrderHeld \land NoOrphan
\]

----
## 63. O4 — Consuming Value Transfer

**Preconditions**

1. `source` and `destination` are usable, and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over their relevant footprints.
2. Source and destination have the **same shape of ordered subtrees**. The `i`-th child of each source part corresponds to the `i`-th child of the corresponding destination part; all nodes are matched. Structural field identity is positional, not an arbitrary matching of children.
3. **All** source leaves are `Init`, and **no** destination leaf is `Init`. The source and destination footprints are disjoint.
4. No exclusive authority is duplicated; validity of derived authorities and active projections is preserved. No active derived authority held outside `source` covers a source leaf, except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `source`: the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain. Other active authorities remain subject to this check. Authorities held by parts of `source` are transferred with the value and are controlled by §63.8.
5. **No in-place source leaf is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). Storage merely **owned** by the source, which is not itself moved by the transfer of that value, does not prevent this transfer.
6. Dependencies of all still-usable places following the value remain valid; non-escape constraints and `AnchorOrder` are checked in the **resulting state**, including transferred anchors of owned places that remain usable.
7. All moved held authorities, including those of owned storage, satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state; no authority may escape a local anchor on the grounds that its containing value was transferred.
8. **Local self-blocking prevention:** For each active authority held before the step by a part `r` of `source` whose holder becomes the corresponding part `corr(r)` of `destination`, that authority's footprint contains **no leaf** of `corr(r)` in the resulting state. Transfer is rejected if this local check fails; no global authority-acyclicity check is imposed.
9. **Destination usability:** `destination` is usable in the resulting state.

**`ok` effect:**

- every source leaf becomes `Moved` and each corresponding destination leaf becomes `Init`;
- every authority held by source part `r` acquires as its new holder the corresponding destination part `corr(r)`, not indiscriminately the destination root;
- places owned by `r` become owned by `corr(r)`; their roots follow this owner according to `RootHeld`;
- value dependencies follow the corresponding places under validity guarantees; no authority is created or duplicated;
- destination places receive the transferred values and rights without automatically moving storage not owned by a source part.

**Other outcome:** `reject`. `transfer` to a call result is subject to these same rules.

A partially initialized structure may be transferred **field by field**, but only for fields individually eligible for transfer. This does not automatically destructure a value that owns storage **at the container level**: that storage stays with the container if the container is not transferred. Conversion between structures with permuted fields must be handled separately, not as a `transfer`.

## 64. O5 — Explicit Attachment of an Anchor

**Preconditions**

1. `result` is a usable place over which the current frame has exercisable `Modify`.
2. `anchor` designates an active, valid authority representing a real dependency of the relevant rights or storage; a declared dependency cannot extend an origin's lifetime.
3. Existing anchors are preserved and the addition respects `AnchorOrder`: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an ancestor thereof.
4. Every dependency carried by a contained value remains represented in the transitive obligations of its container.

**`ok` effect:** `anchor` is added to `D(result)`; the container's transitive dependencies account for it. No additional access right is created. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

A safe interface must declare dependencies covering those actually required by its implementation; the annotation itself is not presumed true. An unsafe abstraction bears the obligations of its contract.

## 65. O8 — Controlled Storage of an Authority

**Preconditions**

1. `authority` is active, **derived**, and held by the current frame; a root authority can never be stored by `store`.
2. `target` is a usable **leaf** under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. It holds no other **active** authority. Its data already being `Init` does not by itself prohibit the operation.
3. The stored authority covers neither a leaf of `target` nor the leaves of storage transitively owned by it.
4. The effective anchor of `authority` respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`; other dependencies are preserved.
5. **In the resulting state**, `target` remains under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame (`store_keeps_target_reachable`), and `AnchorOrderHeld` remains true. This is a genuine additional precondition, not an automatic consequence of the preceding ones.

**`ok` effect:** The holder of `authority` becomes `target`; the authority is added to `D(target)`; **only** leaf `target` becomes `Init`. Other fields of a structure, even adjacent ones, do not change their initialization state. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

Overwriting an active authority already held by the leaf is prohibited; its explicit release may make the target reusable. The resulting-state clause does not by itself prohibit all cycles possible after other operations: general freedom from blocking (`NoLock`) is not adopted here.

# X. Reading, Writing, and Initialization

A leaf's initialization state and the effective right to access it are two distinct conditions.

## 66. O9 — Safe Reading of Regions

**Preconditions**

1. Every leaf being read belongs to a usable place and is `Init`.
2. `access` is an authority exercisable in `Observe` mode over the region; its **effective** mode actually permits observation of each leaf being read.
3. Required anchors are valid, and the type and storage contract permits this read.

**`ok` effect:** The logical read succeeds, without modifying `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D`, or arena entries. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

`Moved` and `Uninit` cannot be read. This definition does not replace concrete representation and pointer checks of the elementary memory machine.

## 67. O10 — Ordinary Write

**Preconditions**

1. Targeted leaves belong to usable places, and `access` is exercisable in `Modify` mode with **effective** `Modify` right over each leaf.
2. No incompatible ordinary authority holds an incompatible effective mode over the written leaves (I1).
3. Anchors and constraints of the relevant types, storage, and abstractions remain valid.

**`ok` effect:** The logical write sets the actually written leaves to `Init` and does not modify authorities or their anchors. An unwritten leaf does not become `Init` by this effect. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 68. O11 — Write Under Shared Mutation

**Preconditions**

1. Every leaf in the region is usable and declared `K.SharedMutable`.
2. `access` is exercisable in a mode **at least** `Observe` and has a present effective mode on every leaf, either `Observe` or `Modify`; exercising an authority without an effective mode is insufficient.
3. Dependencies are valid and the particular shared-mutation discipline guaranteed by `K.SharedMutable` applies.

**`ok` effect:** Actually written leaves become `Init`; authorities and their structural exclusivity I1 do not change. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

`writeShared` may update metadata under an `Observe` authority when the contract permits. Stability of observed contents is not automatically guaranteed, and this kernel **does not prove** the absence of data races: that requires the concurrency model's guarantees.

# XI. End of Use, Deallocation, and Allocation

The logical end of a value does not necessarily entail deallocation of its storage. The following operations treat initialization, ownership, and physical release separately.

## 69. O12 — Logical End of a Value's Use

**Preconditions**

1. `place` is usable and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over it.
2. No active descendant over the leaves of `place` **or storage that dies with it** is held outside the places dying with `place`, in a way that would prevent rights from returning or being invalidated. The authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`, namely the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain, are exempt from this check. Moreover, no authority that the effect makes inactive (held by `place` or by a place dying with it, transitively owned storage included) has an active descendant, whatever its footprint, that the same step does not make inactive.
3. No place **remaining usable after the effect** depends on an authority held by `place`, its root, or an authority that would become inactive when an owned holder dies.
4. **No leaf whose use ends, including transitively owned storage, is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). A dynamic pinning obligation must be legally removed by `unpin` before this step.

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename.Derived

/-!
# Renaming of identities: `transfer`

Equivariance of O4 `transfer` (`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §63) under related
states (§38; §49, last paragraph): the helpers of its preconditions (§63.4, §63.6–§63.8), its `ok`
effect, its preconditions (§63.1–§63.9) and the correspondence of its outcomes (§58). Positional
field identity (§63.2) needs `SibMono`.

Iff lemmas are proved in one direction and closed by symmetry (`SRel.symm`, `Sim.symm`,
`KCorr.symm`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

variable {π α : Ren} {s s' : S3} {k k' : K}

/-! ## Effect (§63, `ok` effect) -/

/-- A transfer keeps the origin links (§63, `ok` effect: only holders change). -/
private theorem transfer_org (s : S3) (src dst j : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).org j = s.org j := by
  simp only [S3.org, transfer_A_get]
  cases s.A[j]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- Parent and origin links stay downward after a transfer (§63, `ok` effect; §49.2, §49.5;
§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem transferEff_down (hd : Down s) (src dst : Nat) : Down (transferEff s src dst) :=
  ⟨fun j o hj => hd.1 j o (by rwa [transfer_parentOf] at hj),
   fun j o hj => hd.2 j o (by rwa [transfer_org] at hj)⟩

/-- Anchors moved onto a place correspond up to permutation (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item; §63.2;
§44: `D(p)` is a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem movedTo_perm_ren (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (hs : SibMono π s.P)
    (src dst q : Nat) :
    (movedTo s' (π.f src) (π.f dst) (π.f q)).Perm ((movedTo s src dst q).map α.f) :=
  h.filter_flatMap_D fun r => decide_eq_decide.2 (and_congr (partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 r src)
    (by rw [corr_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 hs]; exact π.option_map_eq_some _ _))

/-- The effect of a transfer is equivariant when `π` keeps field order (§63, `ok` effect; §63.2;
§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem transferEff_ren (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (hs : SibMono π s.P)
    (src dst : Nat) : SRel π α (transferEff s src dst) (transferEff s' (π.f src) (π.f dst)) where
  F := h.F
  nF := h.nF
  P := {
    len := by rw [transfer_len, transfer_len]; exact h.P.len
    get := fun q => by
      rw [transfer_P_get, transfer_P_get, h.P.get]
      cases s.P[q]? with
      | none => rfl
      | some pl =>
        have hh := heldIn_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 src pl.owner
        simp only [Option.map_some]
        by_cases hpl : heldIn s.P src pl.owner
        · rw [if_pos (hh.2 hpl), if_pos hpl, mvTo_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 hs]; rfl
        · rw [if_neg (mt hh.1 hpl), if_neg hpl]
    fix := fun q hq => h.P.fix q (by rwa [transfer_len] at hq) }
  I l := by
    show (if π.f l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f dst) then _ else
      if π.f l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f src) then _ else s'.I (π.f l)) = _
    rw [h.mem_footprint hd hd', h.mem_footprint hd hd', h.I]; rfl
  Alen := by simp only [transferEff, List.length_map]; exact h.Alen
  A x := by
    rw [transfer_A_get, transfer_A_get]
    cases hy : s.A[x]? with
    | none => rw [(h.A_none x).1 hy]; exact .none
    | some y =>
      obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
      rw [hy']
      refine .some ?_
      have hh := heldIn_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 src y.holder
      rw [← hr.holder] at hh
      by_cases hyh : heldIn s.P src y.holder
      · rw [if_pos (hh.2 hyh), if_pos hyh]
        exact { hr with holder := by
          show mvTo s'.P (π.f src) (π.f dst) y'.holder = _
          rw [hr.holder, mvTo_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 hs] }
      · rw [if_neg (mt hh.1 hyh), if_neg hyh]; exact hr
  Afix x hx := h.Afix x (by simpa only [transferEff, List.length_map] using hx)
  D q := by
    show (if partOf s'.P (π.f q) (π.f src) then [] else
      s'.D (π.f q) ++ movedTo s' (π.f src) (π.f dst) (π.f q)).Perm
      ((if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q).map α.f)
    rw [partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1]
    by_cases hq : partOf s.P q src
    · rw [if_pos hq, if_pos hq]; exact .nil
    · rw [if_neg hq, if_neg hq, List.map_append]
      exact (h.D q).append (movedTo_perm_ren h hd hd' hs src dst q)
  dead := h.dead
  pins := h.pins

/-! ## Helpers of the preconditions (§63.4, §63.6–§63.8) -/

/-- `ActiveDerivedOutside` is invariant (§63.4; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.activeDerivedOutside (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
    (src j : Nat) : ActiveDerivedOutside s' (π.f src) (α.f j) ↔ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none j).1 hy]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    rw [hy']
    simp only [OptP, hr.active, hr.origin, hr.holder, heldIn_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1, Ne,
      Option.map_eq_none_iff]
    exact and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ =>
      π.exists_mem_iff hr.mem_footprint fun l => h.mem_footprint hd hd' l src

/-- `HolderMoves` is invariant (§63.6, §63.7; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.holderMoves (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (src : Nat)
    (o : Holder) : HolderMoves s' (π.f src) (o.ren π) ↔ HolderMoves s src o := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => exact Iff.rfl
  | place p =>
    exact or_congr (partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 p src) (ownedIn_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 src p)

/-- `AnchorMoves` is invariant (§63.7; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorMoves (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (src x : Nat) :
    AnchorMoves s' (π.f src) (α.f x) ↔ AnchorMoves s src x := by
  unfold AnchorMoves
  cases hy : s.A[x]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none x).1 hy]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    rw [hy']; simp only [OptP, hr.holder]; exact h.holderMoves hd hd' src y.holder

/-- Dependencies following the value correspond up to permutation (§63.6; §44: `D(p)` is a set;
§49, last paragraph). -/
private theorem movedDeps_perm_ren (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
    (src : Nat) : (movedDeps s' (π.f src)).Perm ((movedDeps s src).map α.f) :=
  h.filter_flatMap_D fun r => decide_eq_decide.2 (or_congr (partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 r src)
    (and_congr (ownedIn_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 src r) (h.usable r)))

/-- Membership in the dependencies following the value is invariant (§63.6; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_movedDeps (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (src x : Nat) :
    α.f x ∈ movedDeps s' (π.f src) ↔ x ∈ movedDeps s src :=
  (movedDeps_perm_ren h hd hd' src).mem_iff.trans (α.mem_map_f _ _)

/-- Leaves of a holder are invariant (§63.8; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_holderLeaves (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (o : Holder)
    (l : Nat) : π.f l ∈ holderLeaves s' (o.ren π) ↔ l ∈ holderLeaves s o := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => simp only [holderLeaves, Holder.ren, List.not_mem_nil]
  | place p => exact h.mem_footprint hd hd' l p

/-- `SelfLock` is invariant (§63.8; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.selfLock (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a : Nat) :
    SelfLock s' (α.f a) ↔ SelfLock s a := by
  unfold SelfLock
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none a).1 hy]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    rw [hy']
    simp only [OptP, hr.active, hr.holder]
    exact and_congr_right fun _ =>
      π.exists_mem_iff hr.mem_footprint fun l => h.mem_holderLeaves hd hd' y.holder l

/-- Local self-blocking prevention is invariant (§63.8; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem noLocalSelfLock_ren (hS : Sim π α s s') (src dst : Nat) :
    NoLocalSelfLock s' (π.f src) (π.f dst) ↔ NoLocalSelfLock s src dst := by
  have he := transferEff_ren hS.rel hS.down hS.down' hS.sib src dst
  unfold NoLocalSelfLock
  refine α.forall_mem_iff hS.rel.mem_rangeA fun j => imp_congr ?_ (not_congr
    (he.selfLock (transferEff_down hS.down src dst) (transferEff_down hS.down' _ _) j))
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [(hS.rel.A_none j).1 hy]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := hS.rel.A_some hy
    rw [hy']; simp only [OptP, hr.holder]
    exact heldIn_ren hS.rel.P hS.down.1 hS.down'.1 src y.holder

/-! ## Preconditions and outcomes (§63.1–§63.9, §58) -/

/-- The clause of §63.7 read on a pair of related resulting states (§63.7; §49, last
paragraph). -/
private theorem transfer_heldClause_ren {e e' : S3} (he : SRel π α e e') (hde : Down e)
    (hde' : Down e') (x q : Nat) :
    OptP (e'.A[α.f x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place (π.f q) →
      EffAnchorOK e' (α.f x) (e'.pframe (π.f q))) True ↔
    OptP (e.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
      EffAnchorOK e x (e.pframe q)) True := by
  cases hy : e.A[x]? with
  | none => rw [(he.A_none x).1 hy]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := he.A_some hy
    rw [hy']
    simp only [OptP, hr.active, hr.holder, he.pframe, he.effAnchorOK hde hde']
    exact imp_congr_right fun _ => imp_congr (Holder.ren_inj π (b := .place q)) Iff.rfl

/-- The preconditions of `transfer` hold forward (§63.1–§63.9; §49, last paragraph). -/
private theorem transferPre_ren_of (hK : KCorr π α k k') (hS : Sim π α s s') {src dst : Nat}
    (hp : TransferPre k s src dst) : TransferPre k' s' (π.f src) (π.f dst) := by
  obtain ⟨h, hd, hd', hs⟩ := hS
  have he := transferEff_ren h hd hd' hs src dst
  have hde := transferEff_down hd src dst
  have hde' := transferEff_down hd' (π.f src) (π.f dst)
  have hfp := fun q l => h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q
  exact {
    srcUsable := (h.usable src).2 hp.srcUsable
    dstUsable := (h.usable dst).2 hp.dstUsable
    srcRight := (h.hasRight hd hd' .modify src).2 hp.srcRight
    dstRight := (h.hasRight hd hd' .modify dst).2 hp.dstRight
    sameShape := (sameShape_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 hs src dst).2 hp.sameShape
    srcInit := (π.forall_mem_iff (hfp src) fun l => by rw [h.I]).2 hp.srcInit
    dstNotInit := (π.forall_mem_iff (hfp dst) fun l => by rw [h.I]).2 hp.dstNotInit
    disjoint := mt (overlap_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 src dst).1 hp.disjoint
    noOutsideDerived := (α.exists_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun g =>
      and_congr (h.grounds hd hd' .modify src g) (α.forall_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun j =>
        imp_congr (h.activeDerivedOutside hd hd' src j) (h.rightChain hd hd' g j))).2
      hp.noOutsideDerived
    notPinned := (π.forall_mem_iff (hfp src) fun l =>
      and_congr (not_congr (hK.pinned l)) (by rw [h.pin])).2 hp.notPinned
    depsValid := (α.forall_mem_iff (h.mem_movedDeps hd hd' src) h.active).2 hp.depsValid
    anchorOrder := (he.anchorOrder hde hde').2 hp.anchorOrder
    anchorOrderHeld := (α.forall_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun x =>
      imp_congr (h.anchorMoves hd hd' src x) (π.forall_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q =>
        imp_congr (he.usable q) (transfer_heldClause_ren he hde hde' x q))).2 hp.anchorOrderHeld
    noSelfLock := (noLocalSelfLock_ren ⟨h, hd, hd', hs⟩ src dst).2 hp.noSelfLock
    dstUsableAfter := (he.usable dst).2 hp.dstUsableAfter }

/-- The preconditions of `transfer` are invariant (§63.1–§63.9; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem transferPre_ren (hK : KCorr π α k k') (hS : Sim π α s s') (src dst : Nat) :
    TransferPre k' s' (π.f src) (π.f dst) ↔ TransferPre k s src dst :=
  ⟨fun hp => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using transferPre_ren_of hK.symm hS.symm hp,
   transferPre_ren_of hK hS⟩

/-- The outcomes of `transfer` correspond under corresponding contracts (§63, §58; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem transfer_corr_of_kCorr (hK : KCorr π α k k') (hS : Sim π α s s') (src dst : Nat) :
    StepCorr π α (TransferStep k src dst s) (TransferStep k' (π.f src) (π.f dst) s') :=
  guarded_corr (transferPre_ren hK hS src dst) fun _ =>
    transferEff_ren hS.rel hS.down hS.down' hS.sib src dst

/-- The outcomes of `transfer` and of its renaming under the renamed contract correspond (§63,
§58; §48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem transfer_corr (hS : Sim π α s s') (src dst : Nat) :
    StepCorr π α (TransferStep k src dst s)
      (TransferStep (k.rename π α) (π.f src) (π.f dst) s') :=
  transfer_corr_of_kCorr (KCorr.rename π α k) hS src dst

/-- An `ok` transfer keeps parent and origin links downward (§63, `ok` effect; §49.2, §49.5; §49,
last paragraph). -/
theorem transfer_down {src dst : Nat} {t : S3} (hd : Down s)
    (hst : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok t)) : Down t := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hst
  exact transferEff_down hd src dst

/-- An `ok` transfer keeps field order: it changes owners, not parents (§63, `ok` effect; §63.2;
§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem transfer_sib {src dst : Nat} {t : S3} (hs : SibMono π s.P)
    (hst : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok t)) : SibMono π t.P := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hst
  exact SibMono.congr (transfer_parentOf s src dst) hs

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

  | frame f => exact Iff.rfl
  | place p =>
    exact or_congr (partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 p src) (ownedIn_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 src p)

/-- `AnchorMoves` is invariant (§63.7; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorMoves (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (src x : Nat) :
    AnchorMoves s' (π.f src) (α.f x) ↔ AnchorMoves s src x := by
  unfold AnchorMoves
  cases hy : s.A[x]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none x).1 hy]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    rw [hy']; simp only [OptP, hr.holder]; exact h.holderMoves hd hd' src y.holder

/-- Dependencies following the value correspond up to permutation (§63.6; §44: `D(p)` is a set;
§49, last paragraph). -/
private theorem movedDeps_perm_ren (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
    (src : Nat) : (movedDeps s' (π.f src)).Perm ((movedDeps s src).map α.f) :=
  h.filter_flatMap_D fun r => decide_eq_decide.2 (or_congr (partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 r src)
    (and_congr (ownedIn_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 src r) (h.usable r)))

/-- Membership in the dependencies following the value is invariant (§63.6; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_movedDeps (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (src x : Nat) :
    α.f x ∈ movedDeps s' (π.f src) ↔ x ∈ movedDeps s src :=
  (movedDeps_perm_ren h hd hd' src).mem_iff.trans (α.mem_map_f _ _)

/-- Leaves of a holder are invariant (§63.8; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_holderLeaves (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (o : Holder)
    (l : Nat) : π.f l ∈ holderLeaves s' (o.ren π) ↔ l ∈ holderLeaves s o := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => simp only [holderLeaves, Holder.ren, List.not_mem_nil]
  | place p => exact h.mem_footprint hd hd' l p

/-- `SelfLock` is invariant (§63.8; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.selfLock (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a : Nat) :
    SelfLock s' (α.f a) ↔ SelfLock s a := by
  unfold SelfLock
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none a).1 hy]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    rw [hy']
    simp only [OptP, hr.active, hr.holder]
    exact and_congr_right fun _ =>
      π.exists_mem_iff hr.mem_footprint fun l => h.mem_holderLeaves hd hd' y.holder l

/-- Local self-blocking prevention is invariant (§63.8; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem noLocalSelfLock_ren (hS : Sim π α s s') (src dst : Nat) :
    NoLocalSelfLock s' (π.f src) (π.f dst) ↔ NoLocalSelfLock s src dst := by
  have he := transferEff_ren hS.rel hS.down hS.down' hS.sib src dst
  unfold NoLocalSelfLock
  refine α.forall_mem_iff hS.rel.mem_rangeA fun j => imp_congr ?_ (not_congr
    (he.selfLock (transferEff_down hS.down src dst) (transferEff_down hS.down' _ _) j))
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [(hS.rel.A_none j).1 hy]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := hS.rel.A_some hy
    rw [hy']; simp only [OptP, hr.holder]
    exact heldIn_ren hS.rel.P hS.down.1 hS.down'.1 src y.holder

/-! ## Preconditions and outcomes (§63.1–§63.9, §58) -/

/-- The clause of §63.7 read on a pair of related resulting states (§63.7; §49, last
paragraph). -/
private theorem transfer_heldClause_ren {e e' : S3} (he : SRel π α e e') (hde : Down e)
    (hde' : Down e') (x q : Nat) :
    OptP (e'.A[α.f x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place (π.f q) →
      EffAnchorOK e' (α.f x) (e'.pframe (π.f q))) True ↔
    OptP (e.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
      EffAnchorOK e x (e.pframe q)) True := by
  cases hy : e.A[x]? with
  | none => rw [(he.A_none x).1 hy]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := he.A_some hy
    rw [hy']
    simp only [OptP, hr.active, hr.holder, he.pframe, he.effAnchorOK hde hde']
    exact imp_congr_right fun _ => imp_congr (Holder.ren_inj π (b := .place q)) Iff.rfl

/-- The preconditions of `transfer` hold forward (§63.1–§63.9; §49, last paragraph). -/
private theorem transferPre_ren_of (hK : KCorr π α k k') (hS : Sim π α s s') {src dst : Nat}
    (hp : TransferPre k s src dst) : TransferPre k' s' (π.f src) (π.f dst) := by
  obtain ⟨h, hd, hd', hs⟩ := hS
  have he := transferEff_ren h hd hd' hs src dst
  have hde := transferEff_down hd src dst
  have hde' := transferEff_down hd' (π.f src) (π.f dst)
  have hfp := fun q l => h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q
  exact {
    srcUsable := (h.usable src).2 hp.srcUsable
    dstUsable := (h.usable dst).2 hp.dstUsable
    srcRight := (h.hasRight hd hd' .modify src).2 hp.srcRight
    dstRight := (h.hasRight hd hd' .modify dst).2 hp.dstRight
    sameShape := (sameShape_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 hs src dst).2 hp.sameShape
    srcInit := (π.forall_mem_iff (hfp src) fun l => by rw [h.I]).2 hp.srcInit
    dstNotInit := (π.forall_mem_iff (hfp dst) fun l => by rw [h.I]).2 hp.dstNotInit
    disjoint := mt (overlap_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 src dst).1 hp.disjoint
    noOutsideDerived := (α.exists_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun g =>
      and_congr (h.grounds hd hd' .modify src g) (α.forall_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun j =>
        imp_congr (h.activeDerivedOutside hd hd' src j) (h.rightChain hd hd' g j))).2
      hp.noOutsideDerived
    notPinned := (π.forall_mem_iff (hfp src) fun l =>
      and_congr (not_congr (hK.pinned l)) (by rw [h.pin])).2 hp.notPinned
    depsValid := (α.forall_mem_iff (h.mem_movedDeps hd hd' src) h.active).2 hp.depsValid
    anchorOrder := (he.anchorOrder hde hde').2 hp.anchorOrder
    anchorOrderHeld := (α.forall_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun x =>
      imp_congr (h.anchorMoves hd hd' src x) (π.forall_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q =>
        imp_congr (he.usable q) (transfer_heldClause_ren he hde hde' x q))).2 hp.anchorOrderHeld
    noSelfLock := (noLocalSelfLock_ren ⟨h, hd, hd', hs⟩ src dst).2 hp.noSelfLock
    dstUsableAfter := (he.usable dst).2 hp.dstUsableAfter }

/-- The preconditions of `transfer` are invariant (§63.1–§63.9; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem transferPre_ren (hK : KCorr π α k k') (hS : Sim π α s s') (src dst : Nat) :
    TransferPre k' s' (π.f src) (π.f dst) ↔ TransferPre k s src dst :=
  ⟨fun hp => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using transferPre_ren_of hK.symm hS.symm hp,
   transferPre_ren_of hK hS⟩

/-- The outcomes of `transfer` correspond under corresponding contracts (§63, §58; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem transfer_corr_of_kCorr (hK : KCorr π α k k') (hS : Sim π α s s') (src dst : Nat) :
    StepCorr π α (TransferStep k src dst s) (TransferStep k' (π.f src) (π.f dst) s') :=
  guarded_corr (transferPre_ren hK hS src dst) fun _ =>
    transferEff_ren hS.rel hS.down hS.down' hS.sib src dst

/-- The outcomes of `transfer` and of its renaming under the renamed contract correspond (§63,
§58; §48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem transfer_corr (hS : Sim π α s s') (src dst : Nat) :
    StepCorr π α (TransferStep k src dst s)
      (TransferStep (k.rename π α) (π.f src) (π.f dst) s') :=
  transfer_corr_of_kCorr (KCorr.rename π α k) hS src dst

/-- An `ok` transfer keeps parent and origin links downward (§63, `ok` effect; §49.2, §49.5; §49,
last paragraph). -/
theorem transfer_down {src dst : Nat} {t : S3} (hd : Down s)
    (hst : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok t)) : Down t := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hst
  exact transferEff_down hd src dst

/-- An `ok` transfer keeps field order: it changes owners, not parents (§63, `ok` effect; §63.2;
§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem transfer_sib {src dst : Nat} {t : S3} (hs : SibMono π s.P)
    (hst : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok t)) : SibMono π t.P := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hst
  exact SibMono.congr (transfer_parentOf s src dst) hs

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename
